## File: app/api/auth/set-pin/route.js
````javascript
 1: import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
 2: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
 3: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs'
 4: 
 5: const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 6: const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
 7: 
 8: export async function POST(req) {
 9:   const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey)
10:   const { userId, pin } = await req.json()
11: 
12:   // Validate PIN (Must be 6 digits)
13:   if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(pin)) {
14:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'รหัส PIN ต้องเป็นตัวเลข 6 หลักเท่านั้น' }, { status: 400 })
15:   }
16: 
17:   // Hash the PIN
18:   const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10)
19:   const hashedPin = await bcrypt.hash(pin, salt)
20: 
21:   // Update user_profiles
22:   const { error } = await supabase
23:     .from('user_profiles')
24:     .update({ 
25:       signature_pin: hashedPin,
26:       pin_attempts: 0,
27:       pin_locked_until: null 
28:     })
29:     .eq('id', userId)
30: 
31:   if (error) {
32:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 })
33:   }
34: 
35:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
36: }
````

## File: app/api/guest/reset-pin/route.js
````javascript
 1: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'
 2: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs'
 3: 
 4: // POST /api/guest/reset-pin
 5: export async function POST(request) {
 6:   try {
 7:     const { email } = await request.json()
 8:     if (!email) return Response.json({ error: 'กรุณากรอก Email' }, { status: 400 })
 9: 
10:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
11: 
12:     // 1. ตรวจสอบว่ามี Guest นี้จริงไหม
13:     const { data: guest, error } = await adminClient
14:       .from('external_users')
15:       .select('*')
16:       .eq('email', email)
17:       .single()
18: 
19:     if (error || !guest) {
20:       // เพื่อความปลอดภัย ไม่ควรบอกว่าไม่พบ email จริงๆ 
21:       // แต่ในระบบปิดแบบนี้ บอกไปเพื่อความสะดวกได้ครับ
22:       return Response.json({ error: 'ไม่พบข้อมูลบัญชี Guest นี้ในระบบ' }, { status: 404 })
23:     }
24: 
25:     // 2. สุ่ม PIN ใหม่ 6 หลัก
26:     const newPin = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString()
27:     const pinHash = await bcrypt.hash(newPin, 10)
28: 
29:     // 3. อัปเดตในฐานข้อมูล
30:     const { error: updateError } = await adminClient
31:       .from('external_users')
32:       .update({ pin_hash: pinHash })
33:       .eq('id', guest.id)
34: 
35:     if (updateError) return Response.json({ error: updateError.message }, { status: 400 })
36: 
37:     // 4. ส่ง Email แจ้ง PIN ใหม่
38:     const { sendEmail } = await import('@/lib/resend')
39: 
40:     const { error: emailError } = await sendEmail({
41:       to: email,
42:       subject: '[DOWA IT] รหัส PIN ใหม่ของคุณสำหรับ Guest Access',
43:       html: `
44:         <div style="font-family:sans-serif;max-width:500px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:16px">
45:           <h2 style="color:#2563eb">🔐 รหัส PIN ใหม่ของคุณ</h2>
46:           <p>เรียน คุณ${guest.full_name},</p>
47:           <p>คุณได้ทำการขอรีเซ็ตรหัส PIN สำหรับเข้าใช้งานระบบ DOWA IT ในฐานะ Guest</p>
48:           <div style="background:#f1f5f9;padding:24px;text-align:center;border-radius:12px;margin:20px 0">
49:             <span style="font-size:32px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:8px;color:#1e293b">${newPin}</span>
50:           </div>
51:           <p style="color:#ef4444;font-size:13px"><b>ข้อควรระวัง:</b> กรุณาเปลี่ยน PIN หรือเก็บรักษาเป็นความลับ และรหัสนี้มีผลทันที</p>
52:           <hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;margin:20px 0" />
53:           <p style="font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8">
54:             หากคุณไม่ได้เป็นผู้ร้องขอ กรุณาติดต่อฝ่าย IT ทันที
55:           </p>
56:         </div>
57:       `,
58:     })
59: 
60:     if (emailError) {
61:       console.error('Email error:', emailError)
62:       return Response.json({ error: 'เปลี่ยน PIN สำเร็จแต่ส่งอีเมลไม่สำเร็จ' }, { status: 500 })
63:     }
64: 
65:     return Response.json({ success: true })
66: 
67:   } catch (err) {
68:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
69:   }
70: }
````

## File: app/api/upload/onedrive/route.js
````javascript
 1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
 2: import { uploadToOneDrive, deleteFromOneDrive, getOneDriveFileContent } from '@/lib/onedrive';
 3: 
 4: /**
 5:  * GET: Fetch image from OneDrive for preview
 6:  */
 7: export async function GET(req) {
 8:   try {
 9:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
10:     const path = searchParams.get('path');
11:     const id = searchParams.get('id');
12: 
13:     if (!path && !id) {
14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing path or id' }, { status: 400 });
15:     }
16: 
17:     const buffer = await getOneDriveFileContent(path || id);
18:     
19:     return new Response(buffer, {
20:       headers: {
21:         'Content-Type': 'image/jpeg',
22:         'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=3600',
23:       },
24:     });
25:   } catch (error) {
26:     console.error('OneDrive GET Error:', error);
27:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
28:   }
29: }
30: 
31: /**
32:  * POST: Upload image (supports FormData or JSON/Base64)
33:  */
34: export async function POST(req) {
35:   try {
36:     let buffer, fileName, folderPath;
37:     const contentType = req.headers.get('content-type') || '';
38: 
39:     if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
40:       const body = await req.json();
41:       if (!body.base64Data) throw new Error('Missing base64Data');
42:       buffer = Buffer.from(body.base64Data, 'base64');
43:       fileName = body.fileName || `upload_${Date.now()}.jpg`;
44:       folderPath = body.folderPath || 'Apps/Dowa-IT-System';
45:     } else {
46:       const formData = await req.formData();
47:       const file = formData.get('file');
48:       if (!file) throw new Error('No file uploaded');
49:       buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
50:       fileName = file.name;
51:       folderPath = formData.get('folderPath') || 'Apps/Dowa-IT-System';
52:     }
53: 
54:     const result = await uploadToOneDrive(buffer, fileName, folderPath);
55: 
56:     return NextResponse.json({ 
57:       success: true, 
58:       filePath: result.id // We'll store ID as it's more reliable for deletion/fetch
59:     });
60:   } catch (error) {
61:     console.error('OneDrive POST Error:', error);
62:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
63:   }
64: }
65: 
66: /**
67:  * DELETE: Remove image from OneDrive
68:  */
69: export async function DELETE(req) {
70:   try {
71:     const body = await req.json();
72:     const filePath = body.filePath; // This is the ID we stored
73: 
74:     if (!filePath) {
75:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing filePath (id)' }, { status: 400 });
76:     }
77: 
78:     await deleteFromOneDrive(filePath);
79: 
80:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
81:   } catch (error) {
82:     console.error('OneDrive DELETE Error:', error);
83:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
84:   }
````

## File: app/dashboard/checklist/components/ActionButton.js
````javascript
 1: 'use client'
 2: import { useState } from 'react'
 3: 
 4: export function ActionButton({ onClick, icon, color, title, disabled }) {
 5:   const [hover, setHover] = useState(false)
 6:   
 7:   const colors = {
 8:     blue: { bg: '#eff6ff', icon: '#2563eb', hover: '#dbeafe' },
 9:     red: { bg: '#fef2f2', icon: '#dc2626', hover: '#fee2e2' },
10:     gray: { bg: '#f8fafc', icon: '#64748b', hover: '#f1f5f9' },
11:     green: { bg: '#f0fdf4', icon: '#16a34a', hover: '#dcfce7' },
12:     amber: { bg: '#fffbeb', icon: '#d97706', hover: '#fef3c7' }
13:   }
14:   
15:   const theme = colors[color] || colors.gray
16:   
17:   return (
18:     <button
19:       title={title}
20:       onClick={onClick}
21:       disabled={disabled}
22:       onMouseEnter={() => !disabled && setHover(true)}
23:       onMouseLeave={() => setHover(false)}
24:       style={{
25:         width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 10, border: 'none',
26:         background: disabled ? '#f1f5f9' : (hover ? theme.hover : theme.bg),
27:         color: disabled ? '#cbd5e1' : theme.icon, 
28:         cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
29:         display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
30:         fontSize: 16, transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)',
31:         transform: (hover && !disabled) ? 'translateY(-2px)' : 'none',
32:         boxShadow: (hover && !disabled) ? '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' : 'none'
33:       }}
34:     >
35:       {icon}
36:     </button>
37:   )
38: }
````

````javascript
  1: 'use client'
  2: import { useState, useRef } from 'react'
  3: import { compressAndWatermark } from '@/lib/image-utils'
  4: 
  5: export default function ChecklistImageUpload({ onUploadSuccess, folderPath = 'Apps/Dowa-IT-System' }) {
  6:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  7:   const [status, setStatus] = useState('')
  8:   const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null)
  9:   const [uploadedItem, setUploadedItem] = useState(null) // เก็บข้อมูลไฟล์ที่อัปโหลดแล้ว
 10:   const fileInputRef = useRef(null)
 11: 
 12:   const handleFileChange = async (e) => {
 13:     const file = e.target.files[0]
 14:     if (!file) return
 15: 
 16:     try {
 17:       setLoading(true)
 18:       setStatus('Processing Image...')
 19:       
 20:       const processedBlob = await compressAndWatermark(file, {
 21:         maxWidth: 1280,
 22:         quality: 0.75,
 23:         watermarkText: 'DOWA IT SYSTEM'
 24:       })
 25: 
 26:       const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(processedBlob)
 27:       setPreview(previewUrl)
 28:       setStatus('Uploading to OneDrive...')
 29: 
 30:       const formData = new FormData()
 31:       formData.append('file', processedBlob, file.name)
 32:       formData.append('folderPath', folderPath)
 33: 
 34:       const response = await fetch('/api/upload/onedrive', {
 35:         method: 'POST',
 36:         body: formData,
 37:       })
 38: 
 39:       const result = await response.json()
 40:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Upload failed')
 41: 
 42:       setUploadedItem(result.data)
 43:       setStatus('Upload Success!')
 44:       if (onUploadSuccess) onUploadSuccess(result.data)
 45:       
 46:     } catch (error) {
 47:       console.error('Upload Error:', error)
 48:       setStatus(`Error: ${error.message}`)
 49:     } finally {
 50:       setLoading(false)
 51:     }
 52:   }
 53: 
 54:   const handleDelete = async () => {
 55:     if (!uploadedItem) {
 56:       setPreview(null)
 57:       setStatus('')
 58:       return
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     try {
 62:       setLoading(true)
 63:       setStatus('Deleting from OneDrive...')
 64:       
 65:       const response = await fetch(`/api/upload/onedrive?itemId=${uploadedItem.id}`, {
 66:         method: 'DELETE',
 67:       })
 68:       
 69:       if (!response.ok) {
 70:         const result = await response.json()
 71:         throw new Error(result.error || 'Delete failed')
 72:       }
 73: 
 74:       setPreview(null)
 75:       setUploadedItem(null)
 76:       setStatus('Deleted. Ready for new upload.')
 77:       if (onUploadSuccess) onUploadSuccess(null)
 78:       
 79:       // Reset input file
 80:       if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''
 81:       
 82:     } catch (error) {
 83:       console.error('Delete Error:', error)
 84:       setStatus(`Error: ${error.message}`)
 85:     } finally {
 86:       setLoading(false)
 87:     }
 88:   }
 89: 
 90:   return (
 91:     <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
 92:       <input 
 93:         type="file" 
 94:         accept="image/*" 
 95:         capture="environment"
 96:         onChange={handleFileChange} 
 97:         style={{ display: 'none' }} 
 98:         ref={fileInputRef}
 99:       />
100:       
101:       <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
102:         {!preview && (
103:           <button 
104:             onClick={() => fileInputRef.current.click()}
105:             disabled={loading}
106:             style={{ 
107:               padding: '10px 20px', 
108:               background: loading ? '#94a3b8' : '#2563eb', 
109:               color: '#fff', 
110:               border: 'none', 
111:               borderRadius: 12, 
112:               cursor: 'pointer',
113:               fontWeight: 600,
114:               fontSize: 14,
115:               display: 'flex',
116:               alignItems: 'center',
117:               gap: 8
118:             }}
119:           >
120:             {loading ? '⏳' : '📷'} {loading ? 'Processing...' : 'Take/Upload Photo'}
121:           </button>
122:         )}
123: 
124:         {status && (
125:           <span style={{ 
126:             fontSize: 12, 
127:             color: status.includes('Error') ? '#ef4444' : '#64748b',
128:             fontWeight: 500
129:           }}>
130:             {status}
131:           </span>
132:         )}
133:       </div>
134: 
135:       {preview && (
136:         <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 'fit-content', marginTop: 10 }}>
137:           <img 
138:             src={preview} 
139:             alt="Preview" 
140:             style={{ 
141:               maxWidth: 200, 
142:               borderRadius: 12, 
143:               border: '2px solid #e2e8f0',
144:               boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
145:               opacity: loading ? 0.5 : 1
146:             }} 
147:           />
148:           <button 
149:             onClick={handleDelete}
150:             disabled={loading}
151:             title="Remove and delete from OneDrive"
152:             style={{ 
153:               position: 'absolute', 
154:               top: -10, 
155:               right: -10, 
156:               background: '#ef4444', 
157:               color: '#fff', 
158:               border: 'none', 
159:               borderRadius: '50%', 
160:               width: 28, 
161:               height: 28, 
162:               cursor: 'pointer',
163:               fontSize: 14,
164:               display: 'flex',
165:               alignItems: 'center',
166:               justifyContent: 'center',
167:               boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
168:               zIndex: 10
169:             }}
170:           >
171:             ✕
172:           </button>
173:         </div>
174:       )}
175:     </div>
176:   )
177: }
````

## File: docs/history/project_summary.md
````markdown
 1: # 🏛️ DOWA IT System - Project Summary
 2: 
 3: เอกสารฉบับนี้เป็นรายงานสรุปโครงสร้างสถาปัตยกรรมและรายละเอียดโฟลเดอร์ระบบ **DOWA IT System** จากการตรวจสอบโค้ดจริง มาตรฐาน และความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างระบบ โดยจัดทำเป็นคู่มือภาพรวมเพื่อความเข้าใจในการพัฒนาต่อยอด UAT และการตรวจสอบประวัติระบบ (Audit Trail)
 4: 
 5: ---
 6: 
 7: ## 🚀 1. ข้อมูลและสแต็กเทคโนโลยี (Technology Stack)
 8: 
 9: ระบบ **DOWA IT System** เป็นเว็บแอปพลิเคชันเกรดพรีเมียมระดับองค์กร (Enterprise Application) ที่ถูกออกแบบมาเพื่อจัดการกระบวนการทำงานด้านไอทีขององค์กร DOWA THT แบบมีธรรมาภิบาลและความปลอดภัยระดับสูงสุด
10: 
11: *   **Core Framework:** [Next.js 15 (App Router)](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/app)
12: *   **Design & UI System:** Tailwind CSS v4 ร่วมกับ CSS Explicit เกรดพรีเมียม (ดีไซน์ Glassmorphism รองรับ Multi-Device อย่างสมบูรณ์แบบตามมาตรฐาน [UI_UX_RESPONSIVE.md](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/docs/standards/UI_UX_RESPONSIVE.md))
13: *   **Database Management:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)
14: *   **Authentication & Security:** Supabase Auth + Microsoft 365 SSO + Local Password + Double-Lock **6-digit PIN System** (เก็บความลับแบบ Bcrypt Hash ภายใต้ตาราง `user_profiles`)
15: *   **Transactional Engine:** Server Actions (Next.js) แยกการประมวลผล Logic ออกจาก Client-side อย่างเป็นรูปธรรมเพื่อความปลอดภัยของสิทธิ์
16: *   **Automated Verification:** ระบบทดสอบอัตโนมัติ [tests/](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/tests) สำหรับการยืนยันผลระบบ (npm test)
17: 
18: ---
19: 
20: ## 🧠 2. สถาปัตยกรรมโมดูลหลัก (Core Modules & Engines)
21: 
22: ระบบถูกออกแบบโดยยึดความเสถียรและมาตรฐานของตารางข้อมูลเป็นหลัก โดยประกอบด้วย Engine สำคัญ 5 ส่วน:
23: 
24: ```mermaid
25: graph TD
26:     A["Identity & Security (RBAC/PIN)"] --> B["Unified Workflow Engine"]
27:     C["IT Checklist Engine (Target Master)"] --> B
28:     D["Incident Management"] --> B
29:     B --> E["document_approvals (Transactional Store)"]
30:     E --> F["Global Dashboard & SLA Reports"]
31: ```
32: 
33: ### 1) Identity & Security (ระบบสิทธิ์และความปลอดภัยแบบรวมศูนย์)
34: *   **Source of Truth:** ตาราง `user_profiles` ร่วมกับตาราง `user_whitelist`
35: *   **ระดับของสิทธิ์ (RBAC):** มี 5 บทบาทหลัก ได้แก่ `admin`, `it_staff`, `approver`, `employee`, และ `auditor`
36: *   **ความปลอดภัย:**
37:     *   การทำกิจกรรมสำคัญ (เช่น อนุมัติเบิก/อนุมัติปิดเคส) ต้องผ่านการกรอก PIN 6 หลักที่ผ่านการเข้ารหัส Bcrypt
38:     *   มีระบบ Lockout เมื่อกด PIN ผิดเกิน 5 ครั้งจะถูกระงับสิทธิ์ชั่วคราว 30 นาที
39:     *   ระบบการลงนามแทน (Remote Approval) หาก Admin/IT ได้รับการยืนยัน PIN จากผู้อนุมัติจริง
40: 
41: ### 2) Unified Workflow Engine (ระบบการทำงานแบบอนุมัติร่วม)
42: *   **จุดประสงค์:** จัดการลำดับขั้นและสิทธิ์การลงนามเซ็นเอกสารของทุกตารางในระบบ
43: *   **ฐานข้อมูล:** ตาราง `document_approvals` (เก็บขั้นตอนการเซ็นและประวัติการลงนาม)
44: *   **Logic การประมวลผล:** [workflow.js](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/app/actions/workflow.js) ตรวจสิทธิ์และสร้าง Sequence การอนุมัติอัตโนมัติตามประเภทเอกสาร
45: 
46: ### 3) Incident Management Module (ระบบจัดการเหตุการณ์และปัญหาไอที)
47: *   **จุดประสงค์:** ตรวจสอบกระบวนการตั้งแต่การรับแจ้งเหตุขัดข้อง จนกระทั่งแก้ไขและปิดงาน
48: *   **Logic การประมวลผล:** [incidents.js](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/app/actions/incidents.js) ควบคุมการยอมรับงานด้วยสิทธิ์ `it_staff` และการมอบหมายงานด้วยสิทธิ์ `admin` ตามหลักการตรวจสอบความถูกต้องด้านความปลอดภัย (Audit-Safe Workflow)
49: *   **SLA Engine:** คำนวณระยะเวลาแก้ไขปัญหาแบบวินาทีต่อวินาที โดยอ้างอิงและหักออกด้วยปฏิทินวันหยุดประจำปี ([holidays](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/app/dashboard/settings/holidays/page.js)) และเวลาปิดทำการขององค์กรจริง ผ่าน [slaUtils.js](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/lib/slaUtils.js)
50: 
51: ### 4) IT Checklist Engine & Target Registry (ระบบเช็คลิสต์และบันทึกรายอุปกรณ์)
52: *   **จุดประสงค์:** ควบคุมการทำความสะอาด ตรวจเช็ค และบำรุงรักษาอุปกรณ์ทางไอทีในระดับรายอุปกรณ์
53: *   **ความสามารถหลัก:**
54:     *   **Stable Point-Identity:** การเก็บข้อมูลประวัติตรวจรายข้อด้วย ID (Snapshot-First) แทนการอ้างอิงตำแหน่ง Array ช่วยรักษาประวัติย้อนหลังได้ยาวนาน
55:     *   **QR Deep-Linking:** สแกน QR Code แล้วสามารถนำทางพาเจ้าหน้าที่เข้าไปทำแบบทดสอบหรือตรวจสอบประวัติเครื่องในหน้าจอประวัติอุปกรณ์ได้ทันที
56:     *   **Dual-Write Architecture:** การจัดเก็บภาพหลักฐานคู่ขนานรองรับทั้งโครงสร้างข้อมูลใหม่และเก่าสำหรับช่วงการนำร่อง UAT
57:     *   **Photo Geolocation:** สนับสนุนการเปิดใช้ตำแหน่งพิกัด GPS อัตโนมัติร่วมกับภาพถ่ายหลักฐานเพื่อการตรวจสอบความสัตย์จริงในการลงพื้นที่
58: 
59: ### 5) Global Dashboard & Reporting (หน้าจอรายงานผลสัมฤทธิ์)
60: *   คำนวณและแสดงปริมาณงานรวมที่ผู้ใช้ค้างอนุมัติผ่าน Badge ด้านบนระบบ
61: *   แสดงผล SLA ประจำเคสและค่า KPI ของศูนย์ไอทีแบบเรียลไทม์
62:

72: | **[components/](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/components)** | **UI Shared Components:** เก็บองค์ประกอบหน้าจอที่ใช้ซ้ำเพื่อรักษาเอกภาพของดีไซน์พรีเมียม<br>• `workflow/` – กล่องป๊อปอัปอนุมัติ UnifiedApprovalModal, แถบความคืบหน้า WorkflowProgressBar<br>• `DashboardHeader.js` – แถบหัวระบบสำหรับแสดงจำนวนงานและโปรไฟล์ผู้ใช้ |

74: | **[docs/](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/docs)** | **Project Documentation Index:** คลังความรู้มาตรฐานและประวัติการพัฒนาโครงการ<br>• `standards/` – เอกสารความต้องการเชิงพัฒนาของ Agent และโครงสร้างระบบ (ZERO_HACK, UI_UX_SETTINGS)<br>• `history/` – บันทึกสรุปงานค้าง แผนการพัฒนา และบันทึกประวัติการเปลี่ยนแปลงรายวัน (CHANGELOG)<br>• `manuals/` – คู่มือช่วยเหลือผู้ใช้และแผนนำข้อมูล UAT เข้าสู่ระบบ |
75: | **[supabase/](file:///c:/Users/Lenovo/dowa-it-system/supabase)** | **Supabase Configuration:** ไฟล์การอัปเดตและเก็บประวัติทางโครงสร้างตารางและนโยบายความปลอดภัยฐานข้อมูล<br>• `migrations/` – ลำดับสคริปต์ SQL ที่ใช้เปิดโครงตารางและระบบนโยบายล็อกระดับแถว (RLS Policies) |
````

## File: lib/context/WorkingDateContext.js
````javascript
 1: 'use client'
 2: import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react'
 3: 
 4: const WorkingDateContext = createContext()
 5: 
 6: export function WorkingDateProvider({ children }) {
 7:   const [workingDate, setWorkingDate] = useState(null)
 8: 
 9:   useEffect(() => {
10:     // Load from localStorage on mount
11:     const savedDate = localStorage.getItem('working_date')
12:     if (savedDate) {
13:       setWorkingDate(new Date(savedDate))
14:     } else {
15:       setWorkingDate(new Date())
16:     }
17:   }, [])
18: 
19:   const updateWorkingDate = (date) => {
20:     setWorkingDate(date)
21:     localStorage.setItem('working_date', date.toISOString())
22:   }
23: 
24:   // Helper to get formatted string YYYY-MM-DD
25:   const getFormattedDate = () => {
26:     if (!workingDate) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
27:     const d = new Date(workingDate)
28:     d.setMinutes(d.getMinutes() - d.getTimezoneOffset())
29:     return d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
30:   }
31: 
32:   return (
33:     <WorkingDateContext.Provider value={{ workingDate, setWorkingDate: updateWorkingDate, getFormattedDate }}>
34:       {children}
35:     </WorkingDateContext.Provider>
36:   )
37: }
38: 
39: export const useWorkingDate = () => useContext(WorkingDateContext)
````

````javascript
 1: const MONTHS_TH = ['ม.ค.', 'ก.พ.', 'มี.ค.', 'เม.ย.', 'พ.ค.', 'มิ.ย.', 'ก.ค.', 'ส.ค.', 'ก.ย.', 'ต.ค.', 'พ.ย.', 'ธ.ค.']

 4: export function formatDate(dateStr, lang = 'en', sep = ' / ') {
 5:   if (!dateStr) return '—'
 6:   const d = new Date(dateStr)
 7:   if (isNaN(d)) return '—'
 8:   const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
 9:   const month = lang === 'th' ? MONTHS_TH[d.getMonth()] : MONTHS_EN[d.getMonth()]
10:   const year = lang === 'th' ? d.getFullYear() + 543 : d.getFullYear()
11:   return `${day}${sep}${month}${sep}${year}`
12: }

15: export function formatDateTime(dateStr, lang = 'en', sep = ' / ') {
16:   if (!dateStr) return '—'
17:   const d = new Date(dateStr)
18:   if (isNaN(d)) return '—'
19:   const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
20:   const month = lang === 'th' ? MONTHS_TH[d.getMonth()] : MONTHS_EN[d.getMonth()]
21:   const year = lang === 'th' ? d.getFullYear() + 543 : d.getFullYear()
22:   const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')
23:   const mm = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')
24:   return `${day}${sep}${month}${sep}${year} ${hh}:${mm}`

33:   const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
34:   const year = d.getFullYear()
35:   return `${day}/${month}/${year}`
36: }
37: 
38: export function formatDateMMM(dateStr) {
````

## File: lib/image-utils.js
````javascript
 1: /**
 2:  * Utility for client-side image processing: Compression and Watermarking.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * Compresses an image and applies a watermark.
 7:  * @param {File} file - The original image file.
 8:  * @param {Object} options - Options for processing.
 9:  * @returns {Promise<Blob>} - The processed image as a Blob.
10:  */
11: export const compressAndWatermark = async (file, options = {}) => {
12:   const { 
13:     maxWidth = 1280, 
14:     maxHeight = 1280, 
15:     quality = 0.7, 
16:     watermarkText = 'DOWA IT SYSTEM' 
17:   } = options;
18: 
19:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
20:     const reader = new FileReader();
21:     reader.readAsDataURL(file);
22:     reader.onload = (event) => {
23:       const img = new Image();
24:       img.src = event.target.result;
25:       img.onload = () => {
26:         // Calculate new dimensions
27:         let width = img.width;
28:         let height = img.height;
29: 
30:         if (width > height) {
31:           if (width > maxWidth) {
32:             height *= maxWidth / width;
33:             width = maxWidth;
34:           }
35:         } else {
36:           if (height > maxHeight) {
37:             width *= maxHeight / height;
38:             height = maxHeight;
39:           }
40:         }
41: 
42:         const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
43:         canvas.width = width;
44:         canvas.height = height;
45:         const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
46: 
47:         // Draw image
48:         ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
49: 
50:         // Add Watermark
51:         const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleString('th-TH', { 
52:           year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: '2-digit', 
53:           hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' 
54:         });
55:         
56:         const fullWatermark = `${watermarkText} | ${timestamp}`;
57:         
58:         // Watermark styling
59:         const fontSize = Math.max(14, Math.floor(width / 40));
60:         ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
61:         
62:         // Shadow for readability
63:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)';
64:         ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
65:         ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
66:         ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
67:         
68:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)';
69:         ctx.textAlign = 'right';
70:         ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
71:         
72:         // Draw at bottom right
73:         ctx.fillText(fullWatermark, width - 20, height - 20);
74: 
75:         // Convert to Blob
76:         canvas.toBlob(
77:           (blob) => {
78:             if (blob) resolve(blob);
79:             else reject(new Error('Canvas to Blob conversion failed'));
80:           },
81:           'image/jpeg',
82:           quality
83:         );
84:       };
85:       img.onerror = (err) => reject(err);
86:     };
87:     reader.onerror = (err) => reject(err);
88:   });
89: };
````

## File: lib/onedrive.js
````javascript
  1: /**
  2:  * Utility for OneDrive / Microsoft Graph API interaction.
  3:  * Runs on the server side.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: const TENANT_ID = process.env.MS_GRAPH_TENANT_ID;
  7: const CLIENT_ID = process.env.MS_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID;
  8: const CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.MS_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET;
  9: const USER_EMAIL = process.env.MS_GRAPH_USER_EMAIL || 'admin@dowa-tht.co.th';
 10: 
 11: /**
 12:  * Gets an access token using Client Credentials flow.
 13:  */
 14: async function getAccessToken() {
 15:   if (!TENANT_ID || !CLIENT_ID || !CLIENT_SECRET) {
 16:     throw new Error('Missing Microsoft Graph credentials in environment variables');
 17:   }
 18: 
 19:   const url = `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${TENANT_ID}/oauth2/v2.0/token`;
 20:   const body = new URLSearchParams({
 21:     client_id: CLIENT_ID,
 22:     client_secret: CLIENT_SECRET,
 23:     grant_type: 'client_credentials',
 24:     scope: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/.default',
 25:   });
 26: 
 27:   const response = await fetch(url, {
 28:     method: 'POST',
 29:     body: body,
 30:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
 31:   });
 32: 
 33:   const data = await response.json();
 34:   if (!response.ok) {
 35:     throw new Error(`Failed to get access token: ${data.error_description || data.error}`);
 36:   }
 37: 
 38:   return data.access_token;
 39: }
 40: 
 41: /**
 42:  * Uploads a file to a specific folder in OneDrive.
 43:  * @param {Buffer | ArrayBuffer} fileBuffer - The file content.
 44:  * @param {string} fileName - The name of the file to save as.
 45:  * @param {string} folderPath - The path in OneDrive (relative to root).
 46:  */
 47: export async function uploadToOneDrive(fileBuffer, fileName, folderPath = 'Apps/Dowa-IT-System') {
 48:   const token = await getAccessToken();
 49:   
 50:   // Clean path and build URL
 51:   const cleanPath = folderPath.startsWith('/') ? folderPath.slice(1) : folderPath;
 52:   const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/${USER_EMAIL}/drive/root:/${cleanPath}/${fileName}:/content`;
 53: 
 54:   const response = await fetch(url, {
 55:     method: 'PUT',
 56:     body: fileBuffer,
 57:     headers: {
 58:       'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
 59:       'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
 60:     },
 61:   });
 62: 
 63:   const data = await response.json();
 64:   if (!response.ok) {
 65:     throw new Error(`OneDrive upload failed: ${data.error?.message || response.statusText}`);
 66:   }
 67: 
 68:   return {
 69:     id: data.id,
 70:     name: data.name,
 71:     webUrl: data.webUrl,
 72:     path: data.parentReference.path + '/' + data.name,
 73:   };
 74: }
 75: 
 76: /**
 77:  * Deletes a file from OneDrive using its item ID.
 78:  * @param {string} itemId - The ID of the item to delete.
 79:  */
 80: export async function deleteFromOneDrive(itemId) {
 81:   const token = await getAccessToken();
 82:   const url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/${USER_EMAIL}/drive/items/${itemId}`;
 83: 
 84:   const response = await fetch(url, {
 85:     method: 'DELETE',
 86:     headers: {
 87:       'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
 88:     },
 89:   });
 90: 
 91:   if (!response.ok && response.status !== 204) {
 92:     const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
 93:     throw new Error(`OneDrive delete failed: ${data.error?.message || response.statusText}`);
 94:   }
 95: 
 96:   return { success: true };
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * Fetches a file from OneDrive as a Buffer.
101:  * @param {string} filePathOrId - The path or ID of the file.
102:  */
103: export async function getOneDriveFileContent(filePathOrId) {
104:   const token = await getAccessToken();
105:   let url;
106:   
107:   if (filePathOrId.startsWith('/drive/root:') || filePathOrId.includes('/')) {
108:     const cleanPath = filePathOrId.startsWith('/') ? filePathOrId.slice(1) : filePathOrId;
109:     url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/${USER_EMAIL}/drive/root:/${cleanPath}:/content`;
110:   } else {
111:     url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/${USER_EMAIL}/drive/items/${filePathOrId}/content`;
112:   }
113: 
114:   const response = await fetch(url, {
115:     method: 'GET',
116:     headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
117:   });
118: 
119:   if (!response.ok) {
120:     throw new Error(`OneDrive fetch failed: ${response.statusText}`);
121:   }
122: 
123:   const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
124:   return Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
125: }
````

````markdown
 1: # Checklist_Template_Builder_001: Checklist Template Builder UI/UX & Save Logic
 2: 
 3: ## Objective
 4: Develop a premium, responsive UI for the Checklist Template Builder (Template Master) with full save functionality.
 5: 
 6: ## Scope
 7: - Implement the UI in `app/dashboard/settings/checklist-template-builder` as a **client component** (`"use client"`).
 8: - Use Tailwind CSS v4 with the project design system (`cn()` from `clsx/tailwind-merge`).
 9: - Provide a **preview panel** that renders the template in real‑time.
10: - Add server actions to **validate** and **persist** the template configuration to Supabase.
11: - Ensure the page follows the **Settings Design System** (cards, gradients, micro‑animations).
12: 
13: ## Acceptance Criteria
14: 1. A dedicated route `/dashboard/settings/checklist-template-builder` renders the builder page.
15: 2. The UI includes:
16:    - Header with title and help tooltip.
17:    - Form sections for each template type (T0‑T5) with validation.
18:    - Live preview area showing a rendered checklist preview.
19:    - Save button that triggers a server action and displays success/error toast.
20: 3. All components are fully responsive (mobile‑first) and use the **premium design** guidelines.
21: 4. Server‑side code validates `template_config` against the schema defined in `docs/standards/DOCUMENT_MAPPING_STANDARD.md`.
22: 5. Tests exist for the server action (unit test using Vitest) and UI snapshot tests (Playwright).
23: 
24: ## Implementation Steps
25: 1. Create the folder `app/dashboard/settings/checklist-template-builder`.
26: 2. Add `page.tsx` (client component) with the UI layout.
27: 3. Add `components/TemplateForm.tsx` and `components/TemplatePreview.tsx`.
28: 4. Implement server actions in `app/actions/checklist-template.ts`.
29: 5. Write validation schema in `lib/validation.ts`.
30: 6. Add Tailwind config utilities if needed.
31: 7. Write unit tests (`__tests__/checklist-template.test.ts`).
32: 8. Add Playwright visual regression test.
33: 
34: ## Dependencies
35: - `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`
36: - `zod` for validation
37: - Supabase client (server side) generated types.
38: 
39: ## Documentation
40: - Update `docs/standards/DOCUMENT_MAPPING_STANDARD.md` with the new template schema.
41: - Add a link in `docs/history/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE_MASTER_ASSET_HISTORY.md` referencing this task.
42: 
43: ## Estimated Effort
44: - UI & layout: 8 h
45: - Server actions & validation: 6 h
46: - Testing: 4 h
47: - Documentation: 2 h
````

````javascript
117: export async function saveChecklistTemplate(payload) {
118:   try {
119:     const { adminClient } = await requireAdminProfile()
120:     const validation = validateChecklistTemplate(payload)
121: 
122:     if (!validation.success) {
123:       return {
124:         success: false,
125:         error: 'Validation failed',
126:         fieldErrors: validation.errors,
127:       }
128:     }
129: 
130:     const template = validation.data
131:     const existingId = template.id || null
132:     let sortOrder = payload?.sort_order ?? 0
133:     let itemKey = payload?.item_key || ''
134: 
135:     if (!existingId) {
136:       const { data: latestTemplate } = await adminClient
137:         .from('checklist_templates')
138:         .select('sort_order')
139:         .order('sort_order', { ascending: false })
140:         .limit(1)
141:         .maybeSingle()
142: 
143:       sortOrder = (latestTemplate?.sort_order || 0) + 1
144:       itemKey = `custom_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`
145:     }
146: 
147:     const dataToSave = {
148:       category: template.category,
149:       freq_type: template.freq_type,
150:       item_label: template.item_label,
151:       instruction: template.instruction,
152:       ui_template_type: template.ui_template_type,
153:       template_config: template.template_config,
154:       is_active: payload?.is_active !== false,
155:       sort_order: sortOrder,
156:       item_key: itemKey,
157:     }
158: 
159:     const query = existingId
160:       ? adminClient.from('checklist_templates').update(dataToSave).eq('id', existingId).select('*').single()
161:       : adminClient.from('checklist_templates').insert([dataToSave]).select('*').single()
162: 
163:     const { data, error } = await query
164: 
165:     if (error) {
166:       return {
167:         success: false,
168:         error: error.message,
169:       }
170:     }
171: 
172:     const { data: procedurePlans } = await adminClient
173:       .from('checklist_procedure_plans')
174:       .select('id, plan_name, steps')
175:       .order('plan_name')
176: 
177:     revalidatePath('/dashboard/settings/checklist-template-builder')
178:     revalidatePath('/dashboard/settings/checklist-master-data')
179: 
180:     return {
181:       success: true,
182:       template: formatBuilderTemplate(data, (procedurePlans || []).map((plan) => ({
183:         ...plan,
184:         step_count: Array.isArray(plan.steps?.rows) ? plan.steps.rows.length : Array.isArray(plan.steps) ? plan.steps.length : 0,
185:       }))),
186:       message: existingId ? 'บันทึกการแก้ไข Template สำเร็จ' : 'สร้าง Template ใหม่สำเร็จ',
187:     }
188:   } catch (error) {
189:     return {
190:       success: false,
191:       error: error.message,
192:     }
193:   }
194: }
````

## File: app/actions/status.js
````javascript
 1: 'use server'
 2: 
 3: export async function checkUserTier(email) {
 4:   try {
 5:     const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 6:     const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
 7:     
 8:     if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
 9:       console.error('MISSING ENV:', { url: !!supabaseUrl, key: !!serviceKey })
10:       return { success: false, error: 'ระบบขัดข้อง: ไม่พบการตั้งค่า Environment Variables (URL/Key) กรุณา Redeploy บน Vercel' }
11:     }
12: 
13:     const cleanUrl = String(supabaseUrl).endsWith('/') ? String(supabaseUrl).slice(0, -1) : String(supabaseUrl);
14:     const safeEmail = String(email || '').trim();
15: 
16:     if (!safeEmail) return { success: false, error: 'กรุณาระบุอีเมล' }
17: 
18:     // Use Native Fetch to call Supabase REST API (No Library dependency)
19:     const response = await fetch(`${cleanUrl}/rest/v1/user_registry?email=eq.${encodeURIComponent(safeEmail)}&is_active=eq.true&select=user_role`, {
20:       method: 'GET',
21:       headers: {
22:         'apikey': serviceKey,
23:         'Authorization': `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
24:         'Content-Type': 'application/json'
25:       },
26:       cache: 'no-store'
27:     })
28: 
29:     if (!response.ok) {
30:       const errText = await response.text()
31:       throw new Error(`Supabase API Error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`)
32:     }
33: 
34:     const data = await response.json()
35:     
36:     if (!data || data.length === 0) {
37:       return { success: true, tier: 'not_found' }
38:     }
39: 
40:     const registry = data[0]
41:     const role = registry.user_role
42: 
43:     if (['admin', 'it_staff'].includes(role)) {
44:       return { success: true, tier: 'internal', role }
45:     } else if (['approver', 'auditor', 'employee'].includes(role)) {
46:       return { success: true, tier: 'external', role }
47:     }
48: 
49:     return { success: true, tier: 'not_found' }
50:   } catch (err) {
51:     console.error('CRITICAL STATUS ERROR:', err.message)
52:     // Return a specific error string to catch it in page.js
53:     return { success: false, error: `Critical Error: ${err.message}` }
54:   }
55: }
````

````javascript
154: export async function getTargetPointHistory(targetId, pointId) {

159:

161:     const { data: target, error: targetError } = await adminClient
162:       .from('checklist_targets')
163:       .select(TARGET_SELECT)
164:       .eq('id', targetId)
165:       .maybeSingle()
166: 
167:     if (targetError || !target) {
168:       return { success: false, error: targetError?.message || 'ไม่พบข้อมูลอุปกรณ์', history: [] }
169:     }
170: 
171:     // 2. Fetch Docs
172:     const { data: docs, error: docsError } = await adminClient
173:       .from('checklist_docs')
174:       .select('id, doc_no, period_date, status, checked_at')
175:       .eq('target_id', targetId)
176:       .order('period_date', { ascending: false })
177: 
178:     if (docsError) return { success: false, error: docsError.message, history: [] }
179: 
180:     const docIds = (docs || []).map(d => d.id)
181:     if (docIds.length === 0) return { success: true, target: formatTarget(target), history: [] }
182: 
183:     // 3. Fetch Items
184:     const { data: items, error: itemsError } = await adminClient
185:       .from('checklist_items')
186:       .select('id, doc_id, item_label, item_key, template_data')
187:       .in('doc_id', docIds)
188: 
189:     if (itemsError) return { success: false, error: itemsError.message, history: [] }
190: 
191:     const history = []
192:     for (const doc of docs) {
193:       const docItems = items.filter(i => i.doc_id === doc.id)
194:       for (const item of docItems) {
195:         const td = item.template_data || {}
196:         const snapshot = td._snapshot || {}
197:         const type = snapshot.ui_template_type ?? 0
198:         
199:         // Only process photo templates
200:         if (type !== 1 && !item.item_key?.toLowerCase().includes('photo')) continue
201: 
202:         let photoUrl = null
203:         let meta = null
204:         let source = 'identity'
205: 
206:         // A. Try new structure first
207:         if (td.photos_by_point?.[pointId]) {
208:           photoUrl = td.photos_by_point[pointId]
209:           meta = td.photo_meta_by_point?.[pointId]
210:         } 
211:         // B. Legacy fallback
212:         else if (td.photos || td.photo_meta) {
213:           const points = snapshot.config?.photo_points || []
214:           const pIdx = points.findIndex((p, idx) => {
215:             if (typeof p === 'object') return p.point_id === pointId || p.point_code === pointId
216:             // If string, check if P01, P02 matches idx
217:             return `P${(idx + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}` === pointId || p === pointId
218:           })
219: 
220:           if (pIdx !== -1) {
221:             photoUrl = td.photos?.[pIdx]
222:             meta = td.photo_meta?.[pIdx]
223:             source = 'legacy_mapping'
224:           }
225:         }
226: 
227:         if (photoUrl) {
228:           history.push({
229:             doc_id: doc.id,
230:             doc_no: doc.doc_no,
231:             period_date: doc.period_date,
232:             checked_at: doc.checked_at,
233:             photo_url: photoUrl,
234:             meta: meta,
235:             source: source
236:           })
237:         }
238:       }
239:     }
240: 
241:     return {
242:       success: true,
243:       target: formatTarget(target),
244:       point_id: pointId,
245:       history: history
246:     }
247:   } catch (error) {
248:     return { success: false, error: error.message, history: [] }
249:   }
250: }

252: /**
253:  * Resolves a QR code value to either a Target or a specific Point.
254:  * Pattern: [TargetQR] or [TargetQR]#[PointID]
255:  */
256: export async function resolveChecklistQr(qrCode) {
257:   noStore()
258:   if (!qrCode) return { success: false, error: 'กรุณาระบุรหัส QR' }
259: 
260:   try {
261:     const { adminClient } = await requireAdminProfile()
262:     const rawQr = String(qrCode).trim()
263:     
264:     // 1. Try exact match (Target Level)
265:     const { data: target, error: targetError } = await adminClient
266:       .from('checklist_targets')
267:       .select(TARGET_SELECT)
268:       .eq('qr_value', rawQr)
269:       .maybeSingle()
270: 
271:     if (target) {
272:       return {
273:         success: true,
274:         type: 'target',
275:         targetId: target.id,
276:         targetCode: target.target_code,
277:         targetName: target.name,
278:         redirectUrl: `/dashboard/checklist/targets/${target.id}`
279:       }
280:     }
281: 
282:     // 2. Try point-level match ([TargetQR]#[PointID])
283:     if (rawQr.includes('#')) {
284:       const [targetQr, pointId] = rawQr.split('#')
285:       const { data: pTarget } = await adminClient
286:         .from('checklist_targets')
287:         .select('id, target_code, name')
288:         .eq('qr_value', targetQr.trim())
289:         .maybeSingle()
290: 
291:       if (pTarget) {
292:         return {
293:           success: true,
294:           type: 'point',
295:           targetId: pTarget.id,
296:           pointId: pointId.trim(),
297:           targetCode: pTarget.target_code,
298:           targetName: pTarget.name,
299:           redirectUrl: `/dashboard/checklist/targets/${pTarget.id}/points/${pointId.trim()}`
300:         }
301:       }
302:     }
303: 
304:     return {
305:       success: false,
306:       error: 'ไม่พบข้อมูลอุปกรณ์จาก QR นี้',
307:       debug: { rawQr }
308:     }
309:   } catch (error) {
310:     return { success: false, error: error.message }
311:   }
312: }
313: 
314: async function requireAdminProfile() {
315:   const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
316: 
317:   if (!session || session.type !== 'internal') {
318:     throw new Error('กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบก่อนใช้งาน')
319:   }
320: 
321:   const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
322:   const { data: profile, error } = await adminClient
323:     .from('user_profiles')
324:     .select('id, role, is_active, full_name')
325:     .eq('id', session.user.id)
326:     .single()
327: 
328:   if (error || !profile) {
329:     throw new Error('ไม่พบข้อมูลผู้ใช้ในระบบ')
330:   }
331: 
332:   if (!profile.is_active || profile.role !== 'admin') {
333:     throw new Error('คุณไม่มีสิทธิ์จัดการ Target Registry')
334:   }
335: 
336:   return { session, profile, adminClient }
337: }
338: 
339: function normalizeText(value) {
340:   return String(value || '').trim()
341: }
342: 
343: function normalizeMetadata(value) {
344:   if (!value) return {}
345:   if (typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) return value
346: 
347:   try {
348:     const parsed = JSON.parse(String(value))
349:     return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {}
350:   } catch {
351:     return {}
352:   }
353: }
354: 
355: function buildQrValue(targetType, targetCode, qrValue) {
356:   const explicitValue = normalizeText(qrValue)
357:   if (explicitValue) return explicitValue
358: 
359:   const safeType = normalizeText(targetType).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-') || 'TARGET'
360:   const safeCode = normalizeText(targetCode).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-') || Date.now()
361:   return `${safeType}-${safeCode}`
362: }
363: 
364: function validateTargetPayload(payload) {
365:   const target = {
366:     id: payload?.id || null,
367:     target_code: normalizeText(payload?.target_code),
368:     target_type: normalizeText(payload?.target_type),
369:     name: normalizeText(payload?.name),
370:     location: normalizeText(payload?.location),
371:     qr_value: buildQrValue(payload?.target_type, payload?.target_code, payload?.qr_value),
372:     metadata: normalizeMetadata(payload?.metadata),
373:     is_active: payload?.is_active !== false,
374:   }
375: 
376:   const fieldErrors = {}
377:   if (!target.target_code) fieldErrors.target_code = 'กรุณาระบุรหัส Target'
378:   if (!target.target_type) fieldErrors.target_type = 'กรุณาระบุชนิด Target'
379:   if (!target.name) fieldErrors.name = 'กรุณาระบุชื่อ Target'
380:   if (!target.qr_value) fieldErrors.qr_value = 'กรุณาระบุ QR Value'
381: 
382:   return {
383:     success: Object.keys(fieldErrors).length === 0,
384:     data: target,
385:     fieldErrors,
386:   }
387: }
388: 
389: function validateGroupPayload(payload) {
390:   const group = {
391:     id: payload?.id || null,
392:     group_code: normalizeText(payload?.group_code),
393:     group_name: normalizeText(payload?.group_name),
394:     target_type: normalizeText(payload?.target_type),
395:     description: normalizeText(payload?.description),
396:   }
397: 
398:   const fieldErrors = {}
399:   if (!group.group_code) fieldErrors.group_code = 'กรุณาระบุรหัสกลุ่ม'
400:   if (!group.group_name) fieldErrors.group_name = 'กรุณาระบุชื่อกลุ่ม'
401:   if (!group.target_type) fieldErrors.target_type = 'กรุณาระบุชนิด Target'
402: 
403:   return {
404:     success: Object.keys(fieldErrors).length === 0,
405:     data: group,
406:     fieldErrors,
407:   }
408: }
409: 
410: function formatTarget(record) {
411:   return {
412:     id: record.id,
413:     target_code: record.target_code || '',
414:     target_type: record.target_type || '',
415:     name: record.name || '',
416:     location: record.location || '',
417:     qr_value: record.qr_value || '',
418:     metadata: record.metadata || {},
419:     is_active: record.is_active !== false,
420:     created_at: record.created_at,
421:     updated_at: record.updated_at,
422:   }
423: }
424: 
425: function formatGroup(record) {
426:   return {
427:     id: record.id,
428:     group_code: record.group_code || '',
429:     group_name: record.group_name || '',
430:     target_type: record.target_type || '',
431:     description: record.description || '',
432:   }
433: }

435: export async function getTargetRegistryPageData() {
436:   noStore()
437: 
438:   const { profile, adminClient } = await requireAdminProfile()
439: 
440:   const [targetsResult, groupsResult, templatesResult] = await Promise.all([
441:     adminClient
442:       .from('checklist_targets')
443:       .select(TARGET_SELECT)
444:       .order('target_type')
445:       .order('target_code'),
446:     adminClient
447:       .from('checklist_target_groups')
448:       .select(GROUP_SELECT)
449:       .order('target_type')
450:       .order('group_code'),
451:     adminClient
452:       .from('checklist_template_targets')
453:       .select('id, template_id, target_id, target_group_id, target_type, is_active')
454:       .eq('is_active', true),
455:   ])
456: 
457:   if (targetsResult.error) throw new Error(targetsResult.error.message)
458:   if (groupsResult.error) throw new Error(groupsResult.error.message)
459:   if (templatesResult.error) throw new Error(templatesResult.error.message)
460: 
461:   return {

465:       role: profile.role,

473: export async function saveChecklistTarget(payload) {
474:   try {
475:     const { adminClient } = await requireAdminProfile()
476:     const validation = validateTargetPayload(payload)
477: 
478:     if (!validation.success) {
479:       return {
480:         success: false,
481:         error: 'Validation failed',
482:         fieldErrors: validation.fieldErrors,
483:       }
484:     }
485: 
486:     const target = validation.data
487:     const existingId = target.id || null
488:     const duplicateQuery = adminClient
489:       .from('checklist_targets')
490:       .select('id')
491:       .eq('qr_value', target.qr_value)
492: 
493:     const { data: duplicate, error: duplicateError } = existingId
494:       ? await duplicateQuery.neq('id', existingId).maybeSingle()
495:       : await duplicateQuery.maybeSingle()
496: 
497:     if (duplicateError) {
498:       return { success: false, error: duplicateError.message }
499:     }
500: 
501:     if (duplicate) {
502:       return {
503:         success: false,
504:         error: 'QR Value นี้ถูกใช้งานแล้ว',
505:         fieldErrors: { qr_value: 'QR Value นี้ถูกใช้งานแล้ว' },
506:       }
507:     }
508: 
509:     const dataToSave = {
510:       target_code: target.target_code,
511:       target_type: target.target_type,
512:       name: target.name,
513:       location: target.location || null,
514:       qr_value: target.qr_value,
515:       metadata: target.metadata,
516:       is_active: target.is_active,
517:       updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
518:     }
519: 
520:     const query = existingId
521:       ? adminClient.from('checklist_targets').update(dataToSave).eq('id', existingId).select(TARGET_SELECT).single()
522:       : adminClient.from('checklist_targets').insert([dataToSave]).select(TARGET_SELECT).single()
523: 
524:     const { data, error } = await query
525:     if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message }
526: 
527:     revalidatePath('/dashboard/settings/target-registry')
528: 
529:     return {
530:       success: true,
531:       target: formatTarget(data),
532:       message: existingId ? 'บันทึก Target สำเร็จ' : 'สร้าง Target สำเร็จ',
533:     }
534:   } catch (error) {
535:     return { success: false, error: error.message }
536:   }
537: }
538:
````

````javascript
  7: export async function getCurrentUserSession() {
  8:   const cookieStore = await cookies()
  9:   const guestSession = cookieStore.get('guest-session')
 10:   
 11:   if (guestSession) {
 12:     try {
 13:       const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(guestSession.value, 'base64').toString('utf8'))
 14:       if (decoded.exp > Date.now()) {
 15:         return { type: 'external', user: decoded }
 16:       }
 17:     } catch (e) {
 18:       console.error('Invalid guest session cookie')
 19:     }
 20:   }
 21:   
 22:   const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 23:   const supabaseKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
 24:   const supabase = createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, {
 25:     cookies: {
 26:       getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(),
 27:       setAll: (cookiesToSet) => {
 28:         cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options))
 29:       }
 30:     }
 31:   })
 32:   
 33:   const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
 34:   if (user) {
 35:     // 🛡️ [Security Hardening] Check for Auditor Auto-Deactivation
 36:     const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
 37:     const adminClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey)
 38:     
 39:     const { data: profile } = await adminClient
 40:       .from('user_profiles')
 41:       .select('role, expires_at, is_active')
 42:       .eq('id', user.id)
 43:       .single()
 44: 
 45:     if (profile && profile.role === 'auditor' && profile.expires_at) {
 46:       if (new Date(profile.expires_at) < new Date()) {
 47:         // บัญชีหมดอายุ -> สั่ง Deactivate ทันที
 48:         if (profile.is_active) {
 49:           await adminClient.from('user_profiles').update({ is_active: false }).eq('id', user.id)
 50:         }
 51:         await supabase.auth.signOut()
 52:         return null
 53:       }
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     return { type: 'internal', user: user }
 57:   }
 58:   
 59:   return null
 60: }
````

````javascript
 1: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'
 2: import { recordSystemError } from '@/app/actions/workflow'
 3: 
 4: // POST /api/approval/verify
 5: // รับ token + action (approved/rejected) + comment แล้วบันทึกผล
 6: export async function POST(request) {
 7:   try {
 8:     const { token, action, comment } = await request.json()
 9: 
10:     if (!token || !action) {
11:       return Response.json({ error: 'Missing token or action' }, { status: 400 })
12:     }
13: 
14:     if (!['approved', 'rejected'].includes(action)) {
15:       return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid action' }, { status: 400 })
16:     }
17: 
18:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
19: 
20:     // ดึง token record
21:     const { data: tokenRecord, error: fetchError } = await adminClient
22:       .from('approval_tokens')
23:       .select('*')
24:       .eq('token', token)
25:       .single()
26: 
27:     if (fetchError || !tokenRecord) {
28:       return Response.json({ error: 'Token not found' }, { status: 404 })
29:     }
30: 
31:     // ตรวจสอบหมดอายุ
32:     if (new Date(tokenRecord.expires_at) < new Date()) {
33:       return Response.json({ error: 'Token has expired' }, { status: 410 })
34:     }
35: 
36:     // ตรวจสอบว่าใช้ไปแล้วหรือยัง
37:     if (tokenRecord.used_at) {
38:       return Response.json({
39:         error: 'Token already used',
40:         action: tokenRecord.action,
41:       }, { status: 409 })
42:     }
43: 
44:     // บันทึกผลการอนุมัติ
45:     const { error: updateError } = await adminClient
46:       .from('approval_tokens')
47:       .update({
48:         action,
49:         comment: comment || null,
50:         used_at: new Date().toISOString(),
51:         approved_at: action === 'approved' ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
52:       })
53:       .eq('token', token)
54: 
55:     if (updateError) return Response.json({ error: updateError.message }, { status: 400 })
56: 
57:     return Response.json({
58:       success: true,
59:       action,
60:       documentId: tokenRecord.document_id,
61:       documentType: tokenRecord.document_type,
62:       documentTitle: tokenRecord.document_title,
63:     })
64:   } catch (err) {
65:     await recordSystemError('API', `Approval Verify POST failed: ${err.message}`, { error: err })
66:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
67:   }
68: }
69: 
70: // GET /api/approval/verify?token=xxx — ดูข้อมูล token ก่อน approve
71: export async function GET(request) {
72:   try {
73:     const token = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('token')
74:     if (!token) return Response.json({ error: 'Missing token' }, { status: 400 })
75: 
76:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
77:     const { data, error } = await adminClient
78:       .from('approval_tokens')
79:       .select('document_id, document_type, document_title, approver_name, expires_at, used_at, action')
80:       .eq('token', token)
81:       .single()
82: 
83:     if (error || !data) return Response.json({ error: 'Token not found' }, { status: 404 })
84: 
85:     const isExpired = new Date(data.expires_at) < new Date()
86:     return Response.json({ ...data, isExpired })
87:   } catch (err) {
88:     await recordSystemError('API', `Approval Verify GET failed: ${err.message}`, { error: err })
89:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
````

````javascript
 5:     const { email } = await req.json()
 6:     const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 7:     const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
 8:     
 9:     if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
10:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing Env' }, { status: 500 })
11:     }
12: 
13:     const cleanUrl = String(supabaseUrl).endsWith('/') ? String(supabaseUrl).slice(0, -1) : String(supabaseUrl)
14:     const safeEmail = String(email || '').trim()
15: 
16:     if (!safeEmail) {
17:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'กรุณาระบุอีเมล' }, { status: 400 })
18:     }
19: 
20:     const response = await fetch(`${cleanUrl}/rest/v1/user_registry?email=eq.${encodeURIComponent(safeEmail)}&is_active=eq.true&select=user_role`, {
21:       method: 'GET',
22:       headers: {
23:         'apikey': serviceKey,
24:         'Authorization': `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
25:         'Content-Type': 'application/json'
26:       },
27:       cache: 'no-store'
28:     })
29: 
30:     if (!response.ok) {
31:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Supabase API Error' }, { status: response.status })
32:     }
33: 
34:     const data = await response.json()
35:     
36:     if (!data || data.length === 0) {
37:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, tier: 'not_found' })
38:     }
39: 
40:     const role = data[0].user_role
41:     let tier = 'not_found'
42:     
43:     if (['admin', 'it_staff'].includes(role)) {
44:       tier = 'internal'
45:     } else if (['approver', 'auditor', 'employee'].includes(role)) {
46:       tier = 'external'
47:     }
48: 
49:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, tier, role })
50:   } catch (err) {
51:     console.error('API Check Tier Error:', err)
52:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
53:   }
54: }
````

## File: app/api/auth/verify-pin/route.js
````javascript
 1: import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
 2: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
 3: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs'
 4: 
 5: const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 6: const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
 7: 
 8: export async function POST(req) {
 9:   try {
10:     const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey)
11:     const { userId, pin } = await req.json()
12: 
13:     // 1. Fetch user profile
14:     const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabase
15:       .from('user_profiles')
16:       .select('signature_pin, pin_attempts, pin_locked_until')
17:       .eq('id', userId)
18:       .single()
19: 
20:     if (userError || !user) {
21:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'ไม่พบข้อมูลผู้ใช้' }, { status: 404 })
22:     }
23: 
24:     // 2. Check if currently locked
25:     if (user.pin_locked_until) {
26:       const lockedUntil = new Date(user.pin_locked_until)
27:       if (lockedUntil > new Date()) {
28:         return NextResponse.json({ 
29:           success: false, 
30:           error: `บัญชีถูกระงับชั่วคราว กรุณาลองใหม่หลังจาก ${lockedUntil.toLocaleTimeString()}` 
31:         }, { status: 403 })
32:       }
33:     }
34: 
35:     // 3. Verify PIN
36:     const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(pin, user.signature_pin)
37: 
38:     if (isValid) {
39:       // SUCCESS: Reset attempts and lock
40:       await supabase
41:         .from('user_profiles')
42:         .update({ pin_attempts: 0, pin_locked_until: null })
43:         .eq('id', userId)
44: 
45:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
46:     } else {
47:       // FAILURE: Increment attempts
48:       const newAttempts = (user.pin_attempts || 0) + 1
49:       let updateData = { pin_attempts: newAttempts }
50: 
51:       if (newAttempts >= 5) {
52:         const lockUntil = new Date()
53:         lockUntil.setMinutes(lockUntil.getMinutes() + 30) // Lock for 30 mins
54:         updateData.pin_locked_until = lockUntil.toISOString()
55:       }
56: 
57:       await supabase
58:         .from('user_profiles')
59:         .update(updateData)
60:         .eq('id', userId)
61: 
62:       const remaining = 5 - newAttempts
63:       return NextResponse.json({ 
64:         success: false, 
65:         error: newAttempts >= 5 
66:           ? 'คุณกรอกรหัสผิดครบ 5 ครั้ง ระบบถูกระงับ 30 นาที' 
67:           : `รหัส PIN ไม่ถูกต้อง (เหลือโอกาสอีก ${remaining} ครั้ง)` 
68:       }, { status: 401 })
69:     }
70:   } catch (error) {
71:     console.error('Verify PIN API Error:', error)
72:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 })
73:   }
74: }
````

````javascript
13:       created: '2026-04-25T11:22:06.244109+00:00',
14:       ack: '2026-04-25T11:32:06.244Z'
15:     },
16:     {
17:       id: 'a6c2e4d7-3835-4179-a12b-977b623fea28',
18:       no: 'DTT-INC-2604-002',
19:       created: '2026-04-25T11:39:56.169825+00:00',
20:       ack: '2026-04-25T11:49:56.169Z'
21:     }
22:   ]
23: 
24:   const results = []
25:

50:     })
51:

53:   }
54: 
55:   return new Response(JSON.stringify(results), {
56:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
57:   })
58: }
````

````javascript
  1: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'

 15:

 17:     const { data: auditor, error } = await adminClient
 18:       .from('external_users')
 19:       .select('*')
 20:       .eq('email', email)
 21:       .eq('is_active', true)
 22:       .single()
 23: 
 24:     if (error || !auditor) {
 25:       return Response.json({ error: 'ไม่พบข้อมูล Auditor หรือบัญชีถูกระงับ' }, { status: 404 })
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     // 2. ตรวจสอบ Lockout
 29:     if (auditor.pin_locked_until) {
 30:       const lockedUntil = new Date(auditor.pin_locked_until)
 31:       if (lockedUntil > new Date()) {
 32:         return Response.json({ 
 33:           error: `บัญชีถูกระงับชั่วคราว กรุณาลองใหม่หลังจาก ${lockedUntil.toLocaleTimeString()}` 
 34:         }, { status: 403 })
 35:       }
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     // 3. ตรวจสอบวันหมดอายุ
 39:     if (new Date(auditor.expires_at) < new Date()) {
 40:       return Response.json({ error: 'บัญชี Auditor นี้หมดอายุการใช้งานแล้ว' }, { status: 403 })
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     // 4. ตรวจสอบ PIN (bcrypt)
 44:     const isPinValid = await bcrypt.compare(pin, auditor.pin_hash)
 45:     
 46:     if (isPinValid) {
 47:       // SUCCESS: Reset attempts
 48:       await adminClient
 49:         .from('external_users')
 50:         .update({ pin_attempts: 0, pin_locked_until: null, last_accessed_at: new Date().toISOString() })
 51:         .eq('id', auditor.id)
 52:     } else {
 53:       // FAILURE: Increment attempts
 54:       const newAttempts = (auditor.pin_attempts || 0) + 1
 55:       let updateData = { pin_attempts: newAttempts }
 56: 
 57:       if (newAttempts >= 5) {
 58:         const lockUntil = new Date()
 59:         lockUntil.setMinutes(lockUntil.getMinutes() + 30) // Lock for 30 mins
 60:         updateData.pin_locked_until = lockUntil.toISOString()
 61:       }
 62: 
 63:       await adminClient
 64:         .from('external_users')
 65:         .update(updateData)
 66:         .eq('id', auditor.id)
 67: 
 68:       const remaining = 5 - newAttempts
 69:       return Response.json({ 
 70:         error: newAttempts >= 5 
 71:           ? 'คุณกรอก PIN ผิดครบ 5 ครั้ง ระบบถูกระงับ 30 นาที' 
 72:           : `PIN ไม่ถูกต้อง (เหลือโอกาสอีก ${remaining} ครั้ง)` 
 73:       }, { status: 401 })
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     // 5. สร้าง Auditor Session
 77:     const cookieStore = await cookies()
 78:     const auditorData = {
 79:       id: auditor.id,
 80:       email: auditor.email,
 81:       role: auditor.role || 'auditor',
 82:       name: auditor.full_name,
 83:       exp: new Date(auditor.expires_at).getTime()
 84:     }
 85:     
 86:     const sessionToken = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(auditorData)).toString('base64')
 87:

 90:       httpOnly: true,
 91:       secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
 92:       sameSite: 'lax',
 93:       path: '/'
 94:     })
 95:

 97:       success: true, 
 98:       redirect: '/dashboard',
 99:       guestName: guest.full_name 
100:     })
101: 
102:   } catch (err) {
103:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
104:   }
105: }
````

## File: app/api/qr/lookup/route.js
````javascript
 1: 'use server'
 2: 
 3: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
 4: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../../../lib/supabaseAdmin.js'
 5: 
 6: /**
 7:  * API route to resolve a QR value to a target ID.
 8:  * Expects query param `qr_value`.
 9:  * Returns `{ success: true, target: { id, target_code, name, ... } }`
10:  * or `{ success: false, error: '...' }`.
11:  */
12: export async function GET(request) {
13:   const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
14:   const qrValue = String(searchParams.get('qr_value') || '').trim()
15: 
16:   if (!qrValue) {
17:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'qr_value is required' }, { status: 400 })
18:   }
19: 
20:   try {
21:     const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin()
22:     const { data, error } = await supabase
23:       .from('checklist_targets')
24:       .select('id, target_code, target_type, name, location, qr_value, metadata, is_active, created_at, updated_at')
25:       .eq('qr_value', qrValue)
26:       .maybeSingle()
27: 
28:     if (error) {
29:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 })
30:     }
31: 
32:     if (!data) {
33:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Target not found' }, { status: 404 })
34:     }
35: 
36:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, target: data }, { status: 200 })
37:   } catch (error) {
38:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message || 'Unexpected server error' }, { status: 500 })
39:   }
40: }
````

## File: app/api/users/change-role/route.js
````javascript
 1: import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
 2: import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
 3: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'
 4: import { normalizeRole } from '@/lib/auth'
 5: 
 6: async function requireAdmin() {
 7:   const cookieStore = await cookies()
 8:   const supabase = createServerClient(
 9:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
10:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
11:     { cookies: { getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(), setAll: () => {} } }
12:   )
13:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
14:   if (!session) return null
15: 
16:   const { data: profile } = await supabase
17:     .from('user_profiles')
18:     .select('role, id')
19:     .eq('id', session.user.id)
20:     .single()
21: 
22:   const role = normalizeRole(profile?.role)
23:   if (role !== 'admin') return null
24:   return { ...session.user, profileId: profile.id }
25: }
26: 
27: // PATCH /api/users/change-role
28: export async function PATCH(request) {
29:   try {
30:     const caller = await requireAdmin()
31:     if (!caller) {
32:       return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
33:     }
34: 
35:     const { targetUserId, newRole } = await request.json()
36:     if (!targetUserId || !newRole) {
37:       return Response.json({ error: 'Missing targetUserId or newRole' }, { status: 400 })
38:     }
39: 
40:     // ห้ามเปลี่ยน Role ตัวเอง
41:     if (targetUserId === caller.id) {
42:       return Response.json({ error: 'Cannot change your own role' }, { status: 403 })
43:     }
44: 
45:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
46: 
47:     // ตรวจสอบ Admin คนสุดท้าย
48:     if (newRole !== 'admin') {
49:       const { data: admins } = await adminClient
50:         .from('user_profiles')
51:         .select('id')
52:         .eq('role', 'superuser')
53:         .eq('is_active', true)
54: 
55:       const { data: targetProfile } = await adminClient
56:         .from('user_profiles')
57:         .select('role')
58:         .eq('id', targetUserId)
59:         .single()
60: 
61:       if (targetProfile?.role === 'superuser' && admins?.length <= 1) {
62:         return Response.json(
63:           { error: 'ต้องมี Administrator อย่างน้อย 1 Account' },
64:           { status: 403 }
65:         )
66:       }
67:     }
68: 
69:     // อัปเดต user_profiles (ใช้ค่า legacy: superuser / user)
70:     const legacyRole = newRole === 'admin' ? 'admin' : 'user'
71:     const { error } = await adminClient
72:       .from('user_profiles')
73:       .update({ role: legacyRole })
74:       .eq('id', targetUserId)
75: 
76:     if (error) return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 })
77: 
78:     // Sync user_registry
79:     await adminClient
80:       .from('user_registry')
81:       .update({
82:         user_role: newRole,
83:         last_role_changed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
84:         last_role_changed_by: caller.id,
85:       })
86:       .eq('supabase_user_id', targetUserId)
87: 
88:     return Response.json({ success: true })
89:   } catch (err) {
90:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
91:   }
92: }
````

````javascript
 9:   const supabase = createServerClient(

11:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
12:     { cookies: { getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(), setAll: () => {} } }
13:   )
14:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
15:   if (!session) return null
16: 
17:   const { data: profile } = await supabase
18:     .from('user_profiles')
19:     .select('role')
20:     .eq('id', session.user.id)
21:     .single()
22: 
23:   const role = normalizeRole(profile?.role)
24:   if (role !== 'admin') return null
25:   return session.user
26: }
27: 
28: // POST /api/users/create
29: export async function POST(request) {
30:   try {
31:     const caller = await requireAdmin()
32:     if (!caller) {
33:       return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
34:     }
35: 
36:     const { email, password, full_name, role, can_be_assignee } = await request.json()
37: 
38:     if (!email || !password || !full_name) {
39:       return Response.json({ error: 'Missing required fields' }, { status: 400 })
40:     }
41: 
42:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
43: 
44:     // 1. นำสิทธิ์มาทำความสะอาด (Normalization)
45:     const normalizedRole = normalizeRole(role)
46: 
47:     // สร้าง Auth User
48:     const { data: authData, error: authError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.createUser({
49:       email,
50:       password,
51:       email_confirm: true,
52:       user_metadata: { full_name, role: normalizedRole }
53:     })
54:     if (authError) return Response.json({ error: authError.message }, { status: 400 })
55: 
56:     // สร้าง user_profiles
57:     const { error: profileError } = await adminClient
58:       .from('user_profiles')
59:       .insert({
60:         id: authData.user.id,
61:         full_name,
62:         role: normalizedRole,
63:         can_be_assignee: can_be_assignee || false,
64:         is_active: true,
65:       })
66:     if (profileError) return Response.json({ error: profileError.message }, { status: 400 })
67: 
68:     // Sync user_registry
69:     await adminClient.from('user_registry').upsert({
70:       email,
71:       full_name,
72:       user_role: normalizedRole,
73:       supabase_user_id: authData.user.id,
74:       is_active: true,
75:     }, { onConflict: 'email' })
76: 
77:     return Response.json({ success: true, userId: authData.user.id })
78:   } catch (err) {
79:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
80:   }
81: }
````

## File: app/api/users/migrate-tier/route.js
````javascript
  1: import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'
  2: import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
  3: import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
  4: import { normalizeRole } from '@/lib/auth'
  5: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs'
  6: 
  7: async function requireAdmin() {
  8:   const cookieStore = await cookies()
  9:   const supabase = createServerClient(
 10:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
 11:     process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
 12:     { cookies: { getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(), setAll: () => {} } }
 13:   )
 14:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
 15:   if (!session) return null
 16:   const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('user_profiles').select('role').eq('id', session.user.id).single()
 17:   if (normalizeRole(profile?.role) !== 'admin') return null
 18:   return session.user
 19: }
 20: 
 21: // POST /api/users/migrate-tier
 22: export async function POST(request) {
 23:   try {
 24:     const caller = await requireAdmin()
 25:     if (!caller) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
 26: 
 27:     const { email, targetTier, targetRole, pin } = await request.json()
 28:     // targetTier: 'internal' (Tier 1/2) หรือ 'external' (Tier 3/4)
 29:     // targetRole: 'admin', 'it_staff', 'approver', 'auditor', 'employee'
 30: 
 31:     const adminClient = getSupabaseAdmin()
 32: 
 33:     // 1. ดึงข้อมูลปัจจุบันจาก user_registry
 34:     const { data: registry, error: regError } = await adminClient
 35:       .from('user_registry')
 36:       .select('*')
 37:       .eq('email', email)
 38:       .single()
 39: 
 40:     if (regError || !registry) return Response.json({ error: 'User not found in registry' }, { status: 404 })
 41: 
 42:     // --- CASE A: Migrate INTERNAL (Admin/Sup) -> EXTERNAL (Approval/Guest) ---
 43:     if (targetTier === 'external') {
 44:       // 1. ปิดบัญชี Supabase เดิม (ถ้ามี)
 45:       if (registry.supabase_user_id) {
 46:         await adminClient.from('user_profiles').update({ is_active: false }).eq('id', registry.supabase_user_id)
 47:         await adminClient.auth.admin.updateUserById(registry.supabase_user_id, { ban_duration: '1000h' }) // Optional: Soft ban
 48:       }
 49: 
 50:       // 2. สร้าง External User Record
 51:       const defaultPin = pin || Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString()
 52:       const pinHash = await bcrypt.hash(defaultPin, 10)
 53:       
 54:       const { data: extUser, error: extError } = await adminClient
 55:         .from('external_users')
 56:         .insert({
 57:           email: email,
 58:           full_name: registry.full_name,
 59:           role: targetRole, // 'approver', 'auditor' หรือ 'employee'
 60:           pin_hash: pinHash,
 61:           expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(), // 30 days default
 62:           is_active: true
 63:         })
 64:         .select('id')
 65:         .single()
 66: 
 67:       if (extError) return Response.json({ error: extError.message }, { status: 400 })
 68: 
 69:       // 3. อัปเดต Bridge Table
 70:       await adminClient
 71:         .from('user_registry')
 72:         .update({
 73:           user_role: targetRole,
 74:           external_user_id: extUser.id,
 75:           last_role_changed_at: new Date().toISOString()
 76:         })
 77:         .eq('email', email)
 78: 
 79:       return Response.json({ success: true, newPin: pin ? '********' : defaultPin })
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     // --- CASE B: Migrate EXTERNAL -> INTERNAL ---
 83:     if (targetTier === 'internal') {
 84:       // 1. ปิด External Record
 85:       if (registry.external_user_id) {
 86:         await adminClient.from('external_users').update({ is_active: false }).eq('id', registry.external_user_id)
 87:       }
 88: 
 89:       let supabaseId = registry.supabase_user_id
 90: 
 91:       // 2. ตรวจสอบ/สร้าง Supabase Account
 92:       if (!supabaseId) {
 93:         const { data: authData, error: authError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.createUser({
 94:           email,
 95:           email_confirm: true,
 96:           user_metadata: { full_name: registry.full_name }
 97:         })
 98:         if (authError) return Response.json({ error: authError.message }, { status: 400 })
 99:         supabaseId = authData.user.id
100:       } else {
101:         // Re-enable
102:         await adminClient.from('user_profiles').update({ is_active: true }).eq('id', supabaseId)
103:         await adminClient.auth.admin.updateUserById(supabaseId, { ban_duration: 'none' })
104:       }
105: 
106:       // 3. ส่ง Password Reset/Magic Link ให้ User ตั้งรหัสผ่าน
107:       await adminClient.auth.admin.generateLink({
108:         type: 'recovery',
109:         email: email
110:       })
111: 
112:       // 4. อัปเดต Bridge Table
113:       const normalizedRole = normalizeRole(targetRole)
114:       await adminClient
115:         .from('user_registry')
116:         .update({
117:           user_role: normalizedRole,
118:           supabase_user_id: supabaseId,
119:           last_role_changed_at: new Date().toISOString()
120:         })
121:         .eq('email', email)
122:  
123:       // Sync user_profiles
124:       await adminClient.from('user_profiles').upsert({
125:         id: supabaseId,
126:         role: normalizedRole,
127:         full_name: registry.full_name,
128:         is_active: true
129:       })
130: 
131:       return Response.json({ success: true, message: 'Migration successful. Password reset email sent.' })
132:     }
133: 
134:     return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid migration parameters' }, { status: 400 })
135: 
136:   } catch (err) {
137:     return Response.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 })
138:   }
139: }
````

````javascript
 17:   if (!isOpen) return null

 19:   const handleVerify = async () => {

 22:       return

 25:     let res;

 27:       res = await verifyEmployeePIN(memberId || memberName, code)
 28:     } else {

 41:         } else {

 43:         }
 44:       } else {
 45:         setError(res.error || 'รหัส OTP ไม่ถูกต้อง')
 46:       }
 47:     }
 48:   }
 49: 
 50:   const handleRequestOTP = async () => {
 51:     setOtpLoading(true)
 52:     setError('')

 63:       } else {

 94:                 >
````
