  67: export async function syncDynamicWorkflowApprovers(docId, docType) {
  68:   try {
  69:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
  70:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[docType?.toLowerCase()]
  71:     if (!reg) return { success: false, error: 'Invalid document type' }
  72: 
  73:     const { data: doc, error: docErr } = await supabaseAdmin
  74:       .from(reg.table)
  75:       .select('*')
  76:       .eq('id', docId)
  77:       .single()
  78: 
  79:     if (docErr) throw docErr
  80: 
  81:     const { data: steps, error: stepsErr } = await supabaseAdmin
  82:       .from('document_approvals')
  83:       .select('id, role_required, approver_id, status')
  84:       .eq('doc_id', docId)
  85:       .eq('doc_type', docType.toLowerCase())
  86:       .in('status', ['pending', 'waiting'])
  87: 
  88:     if (stepsErr) throw stepsErr
  89: 
  90:     for (const step of steps || []) {
  91:       const resolvedApproverId = await resolveDynamicWorkflowApproverId(step, doc)
  92:       if (resolvedApproverId && resolvedApproverId !== step.approver_id) {
  93:         const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseAdmin
  94:           .from('document_approvals')
  95:           .update({ approver_id: resolvedApproverId })
  96:           .eq('id', step.id)
  97:         if (updateErr) throw updateErr
  98:       }
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     return { success: true }
 102:   } catch (err) {
 103:     console.error('syncDynamicWorkflowApprovers Error:', err)
 104:     return { success: false, error: err.message }
 105:   }
 106: }

 108: export async function diagnoseApprovalPin(docId, docType, stepId, pin) {
 109:   try {
 110:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 111:     if (!session) return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }
 112:     if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(pin || '')) return { success: false, error: 'PIN must be 6 digits' }
 113: 
 114:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 115:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[docType?.toLowerCase()]
 116:     if (!reg) return { success: false, error: 'Invalid document type' }
 117: 
 118:     const syncResult = await syncDynamicWorkflowApprovers(docId, docType)
 119:     if (!syncResult.success) return syncResult
 120: 
 121:     const { data: step, error: stepErr } = await supabaseAdmin
 122:       .from('document_approvals')
 123:       .select('id, doc_id, doc_type, step_order, role_required, approver_id, status')
 124:       .eq('id', stepId)
 125:       .eq('doc_id', docId)
 126:       .eq('doc_type', docType.toLowerCase())
 127:       .maybeSingle()
 128:     if (stepErr) throw stepErr
 129:     if (!step) return { success: false, error: 'Approval step not found' }
 130: 
 131:     const { data: currentProfile, error: currentProfileErr } = await supabaseAdmin
 132:       .from('user_profiles')
 133:       .select('role')
 134:       .eq('id', session.user.id)
 135:       .maybeSingle()
 136:     if (currentProfileErr) throw currentProfileErr
 137: 
 138:     const isDirectApproval = step.approver_id === session.user.id
 139:     const canTestRemote = ['admin', 'it_staff'].includes(currentProfile?.role)
 140:     const canTest = isDirectApproval || canTestRemote
 141:     if (!canTest) return { success: false, error: 'Not authorized to test this approver PIN' }
 142:     if (!step.approver_id) {
 143:       return {
 144:         success: false,
 145:         error: 'Approval step has no approver_id after sync. Fix workflow approver mapping first.',
 146:         step: {
 147:           id: step.id,
 148:           step_order: step.step_order,
 149:           role_required: step.role_required,
 150:           status: step.status,
 151:           has_approver_id: false
 152:         }
 153:       }
 154:     }
 155: 
 156:     const { data: approver, error: approverErr } = await supabaseAdmin
 157:       .from('user_profiles')
 158:       .select('id, full_name, email, role, signature_pin, pin_attempts, pin_locked_until')
 159:       .eq('id', step.approver_id)
 160:       .maybeSingle()
 161:     if (approverErr) throw approverErr
 162:     if (!approver) return { success: false, error: 'Approver profile not found' }
 163: 
 164:     const pinCheck = await verifyEmployeePIN(step.approver_id, pin)
 165:     return {
 166:       success: pinCheck.success,
 167:       error: pinCheck.success ? null : pinCheck.error,
 168:       step: {
 169:         id: step.id,
 170:         step_order: step.step_order,
 171:         role_required: step.role_required,
 172:         status: step.status,
 173:         has_approver_id: Boolean(step.approver_id)
 174:       },
 175:       approver: {
 176:         id: approver.id,
 177:         full_name: approver.full_name,
 178:         email: approver.email,
 179:         role: approver.role,
 180:         has_signature_pin: Boolean(approver.signature_pin),
 181:         pin_attempts: approver.pin_attempts || 0,
 182:         pin_locked_until: approver.pin_locked_until || null
 183:       }
 184:     }

 209: /**
 210:  * 🛡️ Unified Audit Logging System
 211:  * Records activity to module-specific logs and prepares for a centralized audit table.
 212:  */
 213: export async function recordAuditLog({ docId, docType, action, details, userEmail, metadata = {} }) {
 214:   try {
 215:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 216:     const type = docType.toLowerCase()
 217:     
 218:     // 0. Resolve doc_no if missing
 219:     if (!metadata?.doc_no && docId && docType) {
 220:       const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[type]
 221:       if (reg) {
 222:         const { data: doc } = await supabaseAdmin
 223:           .from(reg.table)
 224:           .select(reg.no_field)
 225:           .eq('id', docId)
 226:           .single()
 227:         
 228:         if (doc) {
 229:           if (!metadata) metadata = {}
 230:           if (type === 'checklist') {
 231:             // For checklist, generate readable ID if no_field is just ID
 232:             const { data: c } = await supabaseAdmin.from('checklist_docs').select('freq_type, period_date').eq('id', docId).single()
 233:             if (c) metadata.doc_no = `CHK-${c.period_date}-${c.freq_type?.charAt(0) || '?'}`
 234:           } else {
 235:             metadata.doc_no = doc[reg.no_field]
 236:           }
 237:         }
 238:       }
 239:     }
 240: 
 241:     // 1. Record to system_audit_logs (Centralized)
 242:     const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('system_audit_logs').insert({
 243:       doc_id: docId,
 244:       doc_type: type,
 245:       action: action,
 246:       details: details,
 247:       user_email: userEmail,
 248:       metadata: metadata
 249:     })
 250: 
 251:     if (error) {
 252:       console.error('system_audit_logs Error:', error)
 253:       // Fallback or secondary log could be here, but we prioritize the centralized one
 254:     }
 255: 
 256:     // 2. Backward Compatibility: Record to Legacy Module Logs if needed
 257:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[type]
 258:     if (reg) {
 259:       const table = type === 'checklist' ? 'checklist_logs' : 'incident_logs'
 260:       const fullAction = details ? `${action} | ${details}` : action
 261:       const legacyData = { action: fullAction, user_email: userEmail }
 262:       if (type === 'checklist') legacyData.doc_id = docId; else legacyData.incident_id = docId;
 263:       await supabaseAdmin.from(table).insert(legacyData).catch(e => console.warn('Legacy Logging Warning:', e))
 264:     }
 265: 
 266:     return { success: true }
 267:   } catch (err) {
 268:     console.error('recordAuditLog Error:', err)
 269:     return { success: false, error: err.message }
 270:   }
 271: }
 272:

 276: async function notifyApprover(approverId, docId, docType, docNo, title) {
 277:   try {
 278:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 279:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
 280:       .from('profiles')
 281:       .select('email, full_name')
 282:       .eq('id', approverId)
 283:       .single()
 284: 
 285:     if (!profile?.email) return
 286: 
 287:     const baseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'
 288:     const link = `${baseUrl}/dashboard/${docType === 'incident' ? 'incidents' : 'checklist'}/${docId}`
 289: 
 290:     await sendEmail({
 291:       to: profile.email,
 292:       subject: `[Pending Approval] ${docNo} - ${title}`,
 293:       html: `
 294:         <div style="padding: 24px; background: #f8fafc;">
 295:           <h2 style="color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 16px;">สวัสดีคุณ ${profile.full_name}</h2>
 296:           <p style="color: #475569; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6;">
 297:             มีเอกสารรอการอนุมัติจากคุณในระบบ DOWA IT System
 298:           </p>
 299:           <div style="background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; margin: 24px 0;">
 300:             <p style="margin: 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800;">เลขที่เอกสาร</p>
 301:             <p style="margin: 4px 0 12px 0; color: #1e293b; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700;">${docNo}</p>
 302:             <p style="margin: 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800;">หัวข้อ</p>
 303:             <p style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; color: #1e293b; font-size: 16px;">${title}</p>
 304:           </div>
 305:           <a href="${link}" style="display: inline-block; padding: 14px 28px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700;">
 306:             ไปหน้าตรวจสอบและอนุมัติ
 307:           </a>
 308:         </div>
 309:       `
 310:     })
 311:   } catch (err) {
 312:     console.error('notifyApprover Error:', err)
 313:   }
 314: }

 316: /**
 317:  * 📋 Approval Audit Log
 318:  * Returns ALL document_approvals rows (approved, pending, waiting) across both modules,
 319:  * enriched with document details — one row per sequence step.
 320:  * Used by the "ประวัติการอนุมัติ" tab in /dashboard/approvals.
 321:  */
 322: export async function getApprovalAuditLog({ limit = 200 } = {}) {
 323:   try {
 324:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 325:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
 326: 
 327:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 328: 
 329:     // 1. Fetch all approval steps with approver profile
 330:     const { data: steps, error } = await supabaseAdmin
 331:       .from('document_approvals')
 332:       .select(`
 333:         id, doc_id, doc_type, step_order, status,
 334:         role_required, approver_id, action_at, comment,
 335:         approver:user_profiles!document_approvals_approver_id_fkey(full_name, email)
 336:       `)
 337:       .order('action_at', { ascending: false })
 338:       .limit(limit)
 339: 
 340:     if (error) throw error
 341:     if (!steps || steps.length === 0) return { data: [] }
 342: 
 343:     // 2. Collect doc IDs by type
 344:     const incidentIds = [...new Set(steps.filter(s => s.doc_type === 'incident').map(s => s.doc_id))]
 345:     const checklistIds = [...new Set(steps.filter(s => s.doc_type === 'checklist').map(s => s.doc_id))]
 346: 
 347:     // 3. Fetch document details in parallel
 348:     const [incidentsRes, checklistsRes] = await Promise.all([
 349:       incidentIds.length > 0
 350:         ? supabaseAdmin
 351:             .from('incidents')
 352:             .select('id, case_number, title, reported_by, severity, reporter:user_profiles!incidents_reported_by_id_fkey(full_name)')
 353:             .in('id', incidentIds)
 354:         : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
 355:       checklistIds.length > 0
 356:         ? supabaseAdmin
 357:             .from('checklist_docs')
 358:             .select('id, freq_type, period_date')
 359:             .in('id', checklistIds)
 360:         : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
 361:     ])
 362: 
 363:     const incidentMap = Object.fromEntries((incidentsRes.data || []).map(i => [i.id, i]))
 364:     const checklistMap = Object.fromEntries((checklistsRes.data || []).map(c => [c.id, c]))
 365: 
 366:     // 4. Build unified rows — one row per step
 367:     const rows = steps.map(step => {
 368:       const statusLabel = { approved: 'อนุมัติแล้ว', pending: 'รออนุมัติ', waiting: 'รอลำดับก่อน' }
 369:       const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[step.doc_type]
 370:       if (!reg) return null
 371: 
 372:       if (step.doc_type === 'incident') {
 373:         const inc = incidentMap[step.doc_id]
 374:         if (!inc) return null
 375:         return {
 376:           id: step.id,
 377:           category: 'Incident',
 378:           docId: inc.id,
 379:           docNo: inc[reg.no_field],
 380:           subject: inc[reg.title_field],
 381:           requester: inc.reporter?.full_name || inc.reported_by || '—',
 382:           stepOrder: step.step_order,
 383:           roleRequired: step.role_required,
 384:           approverName: step.approver?.full_name || step.approver?.email || '—',
 385:           status: step.status,
 386:           statusLabel: statusLabel[step.status] || step.status,
 387:           actionAt: step.action_at,
 388:           comment: step.comment,
 389:           link: `/dashboard/incidents/${inc.id}`,
 390:           severity: inc.severity
 391:         }
 392:       } else {
 393:         const chk = checklistMap[step.doc_id]
 394:         if (!chk) return null
 395:         return {
 396:           id: step.id,
 397:           category: 'Checklist',
 398:           docId: chk.id,
 399:           docNo: `CHK-${chk.period_date}-${chk.freq_type?.charAt(0) || '?'}`,
 400:           subject: `IT Checklist (${chk.freq_type}) — ${chk.period_date}`,
 401:           requester: '—',
 402:           stepOrder: step.step_order,
 403:           roleRequired: step.role_required,
 404:           approverName: step.approver?.full_name || step.approver?.email || '—',
 405:           status: step.status,
 406:           statusLabel: statusLabel[step.status] || step.status,
 407:           actionAt: step.action_at,
 408:           comment: step.comment,
 409:           link: `/dashboard/checklist/${chk.id}`,
 410:         }
 411:       }
 412:     }).filter(Boolean)
 413: 
 414:     return { data: rows }
 415:   } catch (err) {
 416:     console.error('getApprovalAuditLog Error:', err)
 417:     return { error: err.message }
 418:   }
 419: }

 421: export async function getUnifiedPendingApprovals() {
 422:   try {
 423:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 424:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
 425: 
 426:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 427: 
 428:     // 1. Get User Profile ID
 429:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
 430:       .from('user_profiles')
 431:       .select('id, full_name, role')
 432:       .eq(session.type === 'internal' ? 'email' : 'id', session.user.email || session.user.id)
 433:       .single()
 434: 
 435:     if (!profile) return { error: 'Profile not found' }
 436: 
 437:     // 2. Fetch Pending Approval Steps first (The source of truth)
 438:     // Refined Query: Strict RBAC — split into 2 queries for reliability
 439:     // 1. If a step has a specific approver_id, ONLY that user sees it.
 440:     // 2. If approver_id is null, anyone with the matching role sees it.
 441:     const [byIdRes, byRoleRes] = await Promise.all([
 442:       supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').select('*').eq('status', 'pending').eq('approver_id', profile.id),
 443:       supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').select('*').eq('status', 'pending').is('approver_id', null).eq('role_required', profile.role)
 444:     ])
 445:     console.log('[DEBUG] profile.id:', profile.id, 'profile.role:', profile.role)
 446:     console.log('[DEBUG] byId count:', byIdRes.data?.length, 'byRole count:', byRoleRes.data?.length)
 447:     console.log('[DEBUG] byId data:', byIdRes.data)
 448:     const pendingSteps = [...(byIdRes.data || []), ...(byRoleRes.data || [])]
 449: 
 450:     if (!pendingSteps || pendingSteps.length === 0) return { data: [] }
 451: 
 452:     const checklistIds = pendingSteps.filter(s => s.doc_type === 'checklist').map(s => s.doc_id)
 453:     const incidentIds = pendingSteps.filter(s => s.doc_type === 'incident').map(s => s.doc_id)
 454: 
 455:     // 3. Fetch Document Details
 456:     const [checklistsRes, incidentsRes] = await Promise.all([
 457:       checklistIds.length > 0 
 458:         ? supabaseAdmin.from('checklist_docs').select('id, freq_type, period_date, status, created_by').in('id', checklistIds)
 459:         : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
 460:       incidentIds.length > 0
 461:         ? supabaseAdmin.from('incidents').select('id, case_number, title, status, created_at, severity, reported_by').in('id', incidentIds)
 462:         : Promise.resolve({ data: [] })
 463:     ])
 464: 
 465:     console.log('[DEBUG] incidentIds:', incidentIds)
 466:     console.log('[DEBUG] incidentsRes:', incidentsRes.data)
 467:     const checklistMap = Object.fromEntries((checklistsRes.data || []).map(c => [c.id, c]))
 468:     const incidentMap = Object.fromEntries((incidentsRes.data || []).map(i => [i.id, i]))
 469: 
 470:     // 4. Transform into Unified Format using pendingSteps as the driver
 471:     const unified = pendingSteps.map(step => {
 472:       if (step.doc_type === 'checklist') {
 473:         const c = checklistMap[step.doc_id]
 474:         if (!c) return null
 475:         return {
 476:           id: c.id,
 477:           category: 'Checklist',
 478:           type: c.freq_type,
 479:           docNo: `CHK-${c.period_date}-${c.freq_type.charAt(0)}`,
 480:           subject: `IT Checklist (${c.freq_type}) - ${c.period_date}`,
 481:           requestDate: c.period_date,
 482:           requester: c.created_by || 'System',
 483:           link: `/dashboard/checklist/${c.id}`
 484:         }
 485:       } else {
 486:         const i = incidentMap[step.doc_id]
 487:         if (!i) return null
 488:         return {
 489:           id: i.id,
 490:           category: 'Incident',
 491:           type: 'Ticket',
 492:           docNo: i.case_number,
 493:           subject: i.title,
 494:           requestDate: i.created_at?.split('T')[0] || 'N/A',
 495:           requester: i.user_profiles?.full_name || 'Unknown',
 496:           link: `/dashboard/incidents/${i.id}`,
 497:           severity: i.severity
 498:         }
 499:       }
 500:     }).filter(Boolean)
 501: 
 502:     // Sort by date descending
 503:     unified.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.requestDate) - new Date(a.requestDate))
 504: 
 505:     return { data: unified }
 506:   } catch (err) {
 507:     console.error('getUnifiedPendingApprovals Error:', err)
 508:     return { error: err.message }
 509:   }
 510: }

 512: export async function getUnifiedMyPendingItems() {
 513:   try {
 514:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 515:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
 516: 
 517:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 518: 
 519:     // 1. Get User Profile
 520:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
 521:       .from('user_profiles')
 522:       .select('id, full_name, email')
 523:       .eq(session.type === 'internal' ? 'email' : 'id', session.user.email || session.user.id)
 524:       .single()
 525: 
 526:     if (!profile) return { error: 'Profile not found' }
 527: 
 528:     // 2. Fetch My Pending Checklists (Sent by me, still pending) — UUID-based
 529:     const { data: checklists } = await supabaseAdmin
 530:       .from('checklist_docs')
 531:       .select(`id, freq_type, period_date, status, workflow_status, created_by, created_by_id, assigned_approver_id`)
 532:       .in('workflow_status', ['pending', 'PENDING'])
 533:       .eq('created_by_id', profile.id)
 534: 
 535:     // 3. Fetch My Pending Incidents (Sent by me OR Reported by me, still pending approval) — UUID-based
 536:     const { data: incidents } = await supabaseAdmin
 537:       .from('incidents')
 538:       .select(`id, case_number, title, status, created_at, reported_by, reported_by_id, assigned_to`)
 539:       .ilike('status', 'Pending Approval')
 540:       .eq('reported_by_id', profile.id)
 541: 
 542:     // 4. Transform into Unified Format
 543:     const unified = [
 544:       ...(checklists || []).map(c => ({
 545:         id: c.id,
 546:         category: 'Checklist',
 547:         type: c.freq_type,
 548:         docNo: `CHK-${c.period_date}-${c.freq_type.charAt(0)}`,
 549:         subject: `IT Checklist (${c.freq_type}) - ${c.period_date}`,
 550:         requestDate: c.period_date,
 551:         status: 'Waiting for Approver',
 552:         link: `/dashboard/checklist/${c.id}`
 553:       })),
 554:       ...(incidents || []).map(i => ({
 555:         id: i.id,
 556:         category: 'Incident',
 557:         type: 'Ticket',
 558:         docNo: i.case_number,
 559:         subject: i.title,
 560:         requestDate: i.created_at.split('T')[0],
 561:         status: 'Waiting for Approval',
 562:         link: `/dashboard/incidents/${i.id}`
 563:       }))
 564:     ]
 565: 
 566:     unified.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.requestDate) - new Date(a.requestDate))
 567:     return { data: unified }
 568:   } catch (err) {
 569:     console.error('getUnifiedMyPendingItems Error:', err)
 570:     return { error: err.message }
 571:   }
 572: }

 574: export async function getSystemLogs(type = 'audit', { page = 0, limit = 20 } = {}) {
 575:   try {
 576:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 577:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
 578: 
 579:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 580:     const from = page * limit
 581:     const to = (page + 1) * limit - 1
 582: 
 583:     if (type === 'login') {
 584:       const { data, error, count } = await supabaseAdmin
 585:         .from('login_logs')
 586:         .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
 587:         .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
 588:         .range(from, to)
 589:       
 590:       if (error) throw error
 591: 
 592:       // Map names for login logs
 593:       const emails = [...new Set(data.map(l => l.user_email).filter(Boolean))]
 594:       const { data: profiles } = await supabaseAdmin.from('user_profiles').select('email, full_name').in('email', emails)
 595:       const nameMap = Object.fromEntries(profiles?.map(p => [p.email, p.full_name]) || [])
 596: 
 597:       const mapped = data.map(l => ({
 598:         ...l,
 599:         full_name: nameMap[l.user_email] || l.user_email
 600:       }))
 601: 
 602:       return { data: mapped, count }
 603:     }
 604: 
 605:     if (type === 'audit') {
 606:       const { data, error, count } = await supabaseAdmin
 607:         .from('system_audit_logs')
 608:         .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
 609:         .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
 610:         .range(from, to)
 611:       
 612:       if (error) throw error
 613: 
 614:       // Fetch names for all emails
 615:       const emails = [...new Set(data.map(l => l.user_email).filter(Boolean))]
 616:       const { data: profiles } = await supabaseAdmin.from('user_profiles').select('email, full_name').in('email', emails)
 617:       const nameMap = Object.fromEntries(profiles?.map(p => [p.email, p.full_name]) || [])
 618: 
 619:       const mapped = data.map(l => ({
 620:         ...l,
 621:         category: l.doc_type === 'checklist' ? 'Checklist' : (l.doc_type === 'incident' ? 'Incident' : l.doc_type),
 622:         full_name: nameMap[l.user_email] || l.user_email,
 623:         docNo: l.metadata?.doc_no || '—'
 624:       }))
 625: 
 626:       return { data: mapped, count }
 627:     }
 628: 
 629:     if (type === 'approval') {
 630:       const { data, error, count } = await supabaseAdmin
 631:         .from('system_audit_logs')
 632:         .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
 633:         .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
 634:         .range(from, to)
 635: 
 636:       if (error) throw error
 637: 
 638:       const emails = [...new Set(data.map(l => l.user_email).filter(Boolean))]
 639:       const { data: profiles } = await supabaseAdmin.from('user_profiles').select('email, full_name').in('email', emails)
 640:       const nameMap = Object.fromEntries(profiles?.map(p => [p.email, p.full_name]) || [])
 641: 
 642:       // Fetch current status for all docs in this page
 643:       const checklistIds = data.filter(l => l.doc_type === 'checklist').map(l => l.doc_id)
 644:       const incidentIds = data.filter(l => l.doc_type === 'incident').map(l => l.doc_id)
 645:       
 646:       const [chkRes, incRes] = await Promise.all([
 647:         checklistIds.length > 0 ? supabaseAdmin.from('checklist_docs').select('id, status, workflow_status').in('id', checklistIds) : { data: [] },
 648:         incidentIds.length > 0 ? supabaseAdmin.from('incidents').select('id, status').in('id', incidentIds) : { data: [] }
 649:       ])
 650:       
 651:       const chkStatusMap = Object.fromEntries(chkRes.data?.map(d => [d.id, d]) || [])
 652:       const incStatusMap = Object.fromEntries(incRes.data?.map(d => [d.id, d]) || [])
 653: 
 654:       const mapped = data.map(l => {
 655:         const cur = l.doc_type === 'checklist' ? chkStatusMap[l.doc_id] : incStatusMap[l.doc_id]
 656:         return {
 657:           id: l.id,
 658:           doc_id: l.doc_id,
 659:           category: l.doc_type === 'checklist' ? 'Checklist' : 'Incident',
 660:           docNo: l.metadata?.doc_no || '—',
 661:           subject: l.details || l.action,
 662:           action: l.action,
 663:           timestamp: l.created_at,
 664:           user: nameMap[l.user_email] || l.user_email,
 665:           current_status: cur?.status,
 666:           current_workflow_status: l.doc_type === 'checklist' ? cur?.workflow_status : (cur?.status === 'Pending Approval' ? 'pending' : 'other')
 667:         }
 668:       })
 669: 
 670:       return { data: mapped, count }
 671:     }
 672: 
 673:     if (type === 'system') {
 674:       const { data, error, count } = await supabaseAdmin
 675:         .from('system_logs')
 676:         .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
 677:         .eq('category', 'error')
 678:         .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
 679:         .range(from, to)
 680:       if (error) throw error
 681:       
 682:       const mapped = data?.map(l => ({
 683:         ...l,
 684:         message: l.details || 'Unknown Error',
 685:         metadata: {
 686:           ...l.metadata,
 687:           source: l.action // Using action column as source for UI display
 688:         }
 689:       })) || []
 690: 
 691:       return { data: mapped, count }
 692:     }
 693: 
 694:     return { data: [], count: 0 }
 695:   } catch (err) {
 696:     console.error('getSystemLogs Error:', err)
 697:     return { error: err.message }
 698:   }
 699: }

 701: /**
 702:  * 🔏 Auto-consume signatures from Resolve dialog into document_approvals steps.
 703:  * 🔏 Phase 1: Apply initial signatures to workflow steps (e.g., during Resolve)
 704:  */
 705: async function applySignaturesToWorkflow(docId, initialSignatures, submitterEmail, reporterPIN = null) {
 706:   if (!initialSignatures) return
 707:   const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 708: 
 709:   // Fetch all steps for this doc ordered by step_order
 710:   const { data: steps } = await supabaseAdmin
 711:     .from('document_approvals')
 712:     .select('*')
 713:     .eq('doc_id', docId)
 714:     .order('step_order')
 715: 
 716:   if (!steps || steps.length === 0) return
 717: 
 718:   // Map step_order to signature data
 719:   const sigMap = {
 720:     1: initialSignatures.it,       // IT Officer
 721:     2: initialSignatures.reporter,  // Reporter / ผู้แจ้ง
 722:     3: initialSignatures.manager,   // Manager (High severity only)
 723:   }
 724: 
 725:   const now = new Date().toISOString()
 726:   let lastApprovedOrder = 0
 727: 
 728:   for (const step of steps) {
 729:     const sigData = sigMap[step.step_order]
 730:     
 731:     // 🛡️ Step 1 (IT Officer) is always approved during Resolve (Log-only)
 732:     if (step.step_order === 1) {
 733:       const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseAdmin
 734:         .from('document_approvals')
 735:         .update({
 736:           status: 'approved',
 737:           approver_id: sigData?.userId || null,
 738:           signature_data: null, 
 739:           action_at: now,
 740:           comment: '(Logged & Verified during Resolve)'
 741:         })
 742:         .eq('id', step.id)
 743: 
 744:       if (updateErr) throw updateErr
 745: 
 746:       await recordLog(
 747:         docId, 'incident',
 748:         'Approved',
 749:         `อนุมัติขั้นที่ 1 | ${sigData?.name || 'IT Officer'} (Auto-approved during Resolve)`,
 750:         submitterEmail
 751:       )
 752:       lastApprovedOrder = 1
 753:       continue
 754:     }
 755: 
 756:     // 🛡️ Step 2 (Reporter) - Optional Auto-approval via PIN
 757:     if (step.step_order === 2) {
 758:       if (reporterPIN) {
 759:         const pinCheck = await verifyEmployeePIN(sigData?.userId, reporterPIN)
 760:         if (!pinCheck.success) {
 761:           throw new Error('รหัส PIN ของผู้แจ้งไม่ถูกต้อง')
 762:         }
 763: 
 764:         const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseAdmin
 765:           .from('document_approvals')
 766:           .update({
 767:             status: 'approved',
 768:             approver_id: sigData?.userId || null,
 769:             signature_data: null, // Log-based
 770:             action_at: now,
 771:             comment: '(Face-to-face approval via PIN during Resolve)'
 772:           })
 773:           .eq('id', step.id)
 774: 
 775:         if (updateErr) throw updateErr
 776: 
 777:         await recordLog(
 778:           docId, 'incident',
 779:           'Approved',
 780:           `อนุมัติขั้นที่ 2 | ${sigData?.name || 'Reporter'} (Verified by PIN during Resolve)`,
 781:           submitterEmail
 782:         )
 783:         lastApprovedOrder = 2
 784:         continue
 785:       } else {
 786:         // No PIN provided, so the reporter must approve manually later.
 787:         // We STOP auto-approving here.
 788:         break
 789:       }
 790:     }
 791: 
 792:     // Step 3 (Manager) - Usually not auto-approved during Resolve unless explicitly handled
 793:     break
 794:   }
 795: 
 796:   // Unlock the NEXT pending step if it exists
 797:   const nextStep = steps.find(s => s.step_order === lastApprovedOrder + 1)
 798:   if (nextStep && nextStep.status === 'waiting') {
 799:     await supabaseAdmin
 800:       .from('document_approvals')
 801:       .update({ status: 'pending' })
 802:       .eq('id', nextStep.id)
 803:   }
 804: }

 806: export async function submitRequest(docId, targetType, triggerKey, userEmail, initialSignatures = null, reporterPIN = null) {
 807:   try {
 808:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
 809:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
 810: 
 811:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 812: 
 813:     // 1. Find the current assigned approver from config
 814:     const { data: config } = await supabaseAdmin
 815:       .from('approval_configs')
 816:       .select('primary_approver_id')
 817:       .eq('target_type', targetType)
 818:       .eq('freq_type', triggerKey)
 819:       .single()
 820: 
 821:     let approverName = 'ระบบ Pool'
 822:     if (config?.primary_approver_id) {
 823:       const { data: apProfile } = await supabaseAdmin
 824:         .from('user_profiles')
 825:         .select('full_name')
 826:         .eq('id', config.primary_approver_id)
 827:         .single()
 828:       if (apProfile) approverName = apProfile.full_name
 829:     }
 830: 
 831:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[targetType]
 832:     if (!reg) return { error: 'Invalid document type' }
 833: 
 834:     // 2. Generate Steps in the new table (Unified Workflow)
 835:     const { success, autoApproved } = await generateWorkflowSteps(docId, targetType, reg.condition_key, triggerKey, config?.primary_approver_id)
 836:     let finalAutoApprove = autoApproved
 837: 
 838:     if (!success) throw new Error('Failed to generate workflow steps')
 839: 
 840:     // 3. Update Document Status
 841:     const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
 842:       .from(reg.table)
 843:       .update({
 844:         [reg.workflow_status_field]: autoApproved ? 'approved' : 'pending',
 845:         [reg.status_field]: autoApproved ? 'Closed' : 'Pending Approval',
 846:         assigned_approver_id: config?.primary_approver_id || null
 847:       })
 848:       .eq('id', docId)
 849:     
 850:     if (error) throw error
 851: 
 852:     await recordLog(docId, targetType, autoApproved ? 'Auto-Approved' : 'Submitted', autoApproved 
 853:       ? 'ระบบอนุมัติงานให้อัตโนมัติตามการตั้งค่า (No approval steps required)' 
 854:       : `ส่งเอกสารเพื่อขออนุมัติ (ผู้อนุมัติหลัก: ${approverName})`, userEmail)
 855: 
 856:     // 🔏 PHASE 1 FIX: Apply signatures from Resolve dialog into workflow steps immediately
 857:     if (targetType === 'incident' && initialSignatures) {
 858:       await applySignaturesToWorkflow(docId, initialSignatures, userEmail, reporterPIN)
 859: 
 860:       // Re-check: if all steps are now approved, close the document
 861:       const { data: allSteps } = await supabaseAdmin
 862:         .from('document_approvals')
 863:         .select('status')
 864:         .eq('doc_id', docId)
 865: 
 866:       const allApproved = allSteps && allSteps.length > 0 && allSteps.every(s => s.status === 'approved')
 867:       if (allApproved) {
 868:         await supabaseAdmin
 869:           .from('incidents')
 870:           .update({ status: 'Closed', workflow_status: 'approved' })
 871:           .eq('id', docId)
 872:         await recordLog(docId, 'incident', 'Auto-Closed', 'ปิดเคสอัตโนมัติ — ลายเซ็นครบทุกขั้นตอน (Resolve)', userEmail)
 873:         await onDocumentFinalApproval(docId, 'incident')
 874:         return { success: true, autoApproved: true, allSigned: true }
 875:       }
 876:     }
 877: 
 878:     // 🛡️ CRITICAL: Handle cross-module sync if auto-approved
 879:     if (finalAutoApprove) {
 880:       await onDocumentFinalApproval(docId, targetType)
 881:     }
 882: 
 883:     // 📧 [Phase 2] Notify Approver
 884:     if (!finalAutoApprove && config?.primary_approver_id) {
 885:       const { data: docData } = await supabaseAdmin.from(reg.table).select(`${reg.no_field}, ${reg.title_field}`).eq('id', docId).single()
 886:       if (docData) {
 887:         await notifyApprover(
 888:           config.primary_approver_id, 
 889:           docId, 
 890:           targetType, 
 891:           docData[reg.no_field], 
 892:           docData[reg.title_field]
 893:         )
 894:       }
 895:     }
 896: 
 897:     return { success: true, autoApproved: finalAutoApprove }
 898:   } catch (err) {
 899:     console.error('submitRequest Error:', err)
 900:     return { success: false, error: err.message }
 901:   }
 902: }

 904: // ==========================================
 905: // UNIFIED WORKFLOW ENGINE FUNCTIONS
 906: // ==========================================
 907: 
 908: export async function generateWorkflowSteps(docId, targetType, configKey, triggerKey, initialApproverId = null) {
 909:   try {
 910:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
 911:     
 912:     // Normalize triggerKey to Integer for routing (Scalable Engine Upgrade)
 913:     const normalizedValue = getMappedWorkflowValue(configKey, triggerKey)
 914: 
 915:     // 1. Get configs for this doc type
 916:     const { data: configs } = await supabaseAdmin
 917:       .from('workflow_configs')
 918:       .select('*')
 919:       .eq('target_type', targetType)
 920:       .eq('condition_key', configKey)
 921:       .eq('condition_value', normalizedValue)
 922:       .eq('is_active', true)
 923:       .order('step_order')
 924: 
 925:     if (!configs || configs.length === 0) return { success: true, autoApproved: true }
 926: 
 927:     // 🛡️ [NEW] Support JSONB Steps from UI Settings
 928:     // หากในแถวแรกมีคอลัมน์ 'steps' ที่เป็น Array ให้ใช้ข้อมูลจากตรงนั้นแทนการใช้ Row-per-step
 929:     let stepsToInsert = []
 930:     const masterConfig = configs[0]
 931: 
 932:     if (Array.isArray(masterConfig.steps) && masterConfig.steps.length > 0) {
 933:       stepsToInsert = masterConfig.steps.map((s, idx) => ({
 934:         doc_id: docId,
 935:         doc_type: targetType,
 936:         step_order: s.step_order || (idx + 1),
 937:         status: idx === 0 ? 'pending' : 'waiting',
 938:         role_required: s.role_required,
 939:         approver_id: s.approver_id || null
 940:       }))
 941:     } else {
 942:       // Legacy Row-per-step logic
 943:       stepsToInsert = configs.map((c, idx) => ({
 944:         doc_id: docId,
 945:         doc_type: targetType,
 946:         step_order: c.step_order,
 947:         status: idx === 0 ? 'pending' : 'waiting',
 948:         role_required: c.role_required,
 949:         approver_id: idx === 0 ? initialApproverId : null
 950:       }))
 951:     }
 952: 
 953:     // 2. [Phase 2 Cleanup] Remove any existing steps to prevent duplicates/conflicts
 954:     await supabaseAdmin
 955:       .from('document_approvals')
 956:       .delete()
 957:       .eq('doc_id', docId)
 958:       .eq('doc_type', targetType)
 959: 
 960:     // 3. [NEW] Dynamic Role Resolution (e.g., 'reporter')
 961:     // If any step requires the reporter, fetch the source document and inject their ID
 962:     if (stepsToInsert.some(s => s.role_required === 'reporter')) {
 963:       const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[targetType?.toLowerCase()]
 964:       if (reg) {
 965:         const { data: doc } = await supabaseAdmin
 966:           .from(reg.table)
 967:           .select('*')
 968:           .eq('id', docId)
 969:           .single()
 970:         
 971:         if (doc) {
 972:           const reporterId = await resolveDynamicWorkflowApproverId({ role_required: 'reporter' }, doc)
 973:           stepsToInsert = stepsToInsert.map(s => 
 974:             s.role_required === 'reporter' ? { ...s, approver_id: reporterId } : s
 975:           )
 976:         }
 977:       }
 978:     }
 979: 
 980:     // 4. Create actual approval steps for this document
 981:     const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').insert(stepsToInsert)
 982:     if (error) throw error
 983: 
 984:     return { success: true, autoApproved: false }
 985:   } catch (err) {
 986:     console.error('generateWorkflowSteps Error:', err)
 987:     return { success: false, error: err.message }
 988:   }
 989: }

1011: /**
1012:  * 🔍 [Phase 2] Preview potential workflow steps before generation
1013:  */
1014: export async function getPotentialWorkflowSteps(targetType, triggerKey) {
1015:   try {
1016:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1017:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[targetType]
1018:     if (!reg) return { data: [] }
1019: 
1020:     const normalizedValue = getMappedWorkflowValue(reg.condition_key, triggerKey)
1021: 
1022:     const { data: configs } = await supabaseAdmin
1023:       .from('workflow_configs')
1024:       .select('*')
1025:       .eq('target_type', targetType)
1026:       .eq('condition_key', reg.condition_key)
1027:       .eq('condition_value', normalizedValue)
1028:       .eq('is_active', true)
1029:       .order('step_order')
1030: 
1031:     if (!configs || configs.length === 0) return { data: [] }
1032: 
1033:     const masterConfig = configs[0]
1034:     let previewSteps = []
1035: 
1036:     if (Array.isArray(masterConfig.steps) && masterConfig.steps.length > 0) {
1037:       // 🛡️ [NEW] Support JSONB Steps from UI Settings for Preview
1038:       previewSteps = masterConfig.steps.map((s, idx) => ({
1039:         id: `preview-${idx}`,
1040:         step_order: s.step_order || (idx + 1),
1041:         role_required: s.role_required,
1042:         approver_id: s.approver_id || null,
1043:         status: 'waiting',
1044:         is_preview: true
1045:       }))
1046:     } else {
1047:       // Legacy Row-per-step logic
1048:       previewSteps = configs.map(c => ({
1049:         id: `preview-${c.id}`,
1050:         step_order: c.step_order,
1051:         role_required: c.role_required,
1052:         approver_id: c.approver_id || null,
1053:         status: 'waiting',
1054:         is_preview: true
1055:       }))
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     // Join with user_profiles for names if approver_id exists
1059:     const approverIds = previewSteps.map(s => s.approver_id).filter(id => id)
1060:     let userMap = {}
1061:     if (approverIds.length > 0) {
1062:       const { data: users } = await supabaseAdmin
1063:         .from('user_profiles')
1064:         .select('id, full_name, role')
1065:         .in('id', approverIds)
1066:       if (users) {
1067:         users.forEach(u => userMap[u.id] = u)
1068:       }
1069:     }
1070: 
1071:     return { 
1072:       data: previewSteps.map(s => ({
1073:         ...s,
1074:         user_profiles: s.approver_id ? userMap[s.approver_id] : null
1075:       }))
1076:     }
1077:   } catch (err) {
1078:     console.error('getPotentialWorkflowSteps Error:', err)
1079:     return { data: [] }
1080:   }
1081: }

1083: export async function rejectDocumentWorkflow(docId, docType, reason) {
1084:   try {
1085:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
1086:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
1087: 
1088:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1089:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[docType.toLowerCase()]
1090:     if (!reg) return { error: 'Invalid document type' }
1091: 
1092:     // 1. Update Main Table
1093:     const { error: updateErr } = await supabaseAdmin
1094:       .from(reg.table)
1095:       .update({
1096:         [reg.workflow_status_field]: 'draft',
1097:         [reg.status_field]: docType.toLowerCase() === 'incident' ? 'In Progress' : 'Open', // Return to editing state
1098:         assigned_approver_id: null
1099:       })
1100:       .eq('id', docId)
1101: 
1102:     if (updateErr) throw updateErr
1103: 
1104:     // 2. Mark current pending steps as rejected
1105:     await supabaseAdmin
1106:       .from('document_approvals')
1107:       .update({ status: 'rejected', comment: `Rejected: ${reason}` })
1108:       .eq('doc_id', docId)
1109:       .eq('status', 'pending')
1110: 
1111:     // 3. Record Log
1112:     await recordLog(docId, docType.toLowerCase(), 'Rejected', `ตีกลับเอกสาร | เหตุผล: ${reason}`, session.user.email)
1113: 
1114:     return { success: true }
1115:   } catch (err) {
1116:     console.error('rejectDocumentWorkflow Error:', err)
1117:     return { error: err.message }
1118:   }
1119: }

1121: export async function submitApprovalStep(docId, docType, stepId, signatureData, comment = '', pin = null, overrideApproverId = null) {
1122:   try {
1123:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
1124:     if (!session) return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
1125: 
1126:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1127: 
1128:     const syncResult = await syncDynamicWorkflowApprovers(docId, docType)
1129:     if (!syncResult.success) return { error: syncResult.error }
1130:      
1131:     // 1. Get current step info
1132:     const { data: currentStep } = await supabaseAdmin
1133:       .from('document_approvals')
1134:       .select('*')
1135:       .eq('id', stepId)
1136:       .single()
1137: 
1138:     if (!currentStep || currentStep.status !== 'pending') return { error: 'Step not ready for approval' }
1139: 
1140:     // 🛡️ SECURITY: PIN Verification Enforcement
1141:     const actualApproverId = currentStep.approver_id || overrideApproverId || session.user.id
1142:     const isDirectApproval = actualApproverId === session.user.id
1143: 
1144:     // หากไม่ใช่เจ้าตัวเซ็นเอง (Remote Approval) "ต้อง" มี PIN และต้องตรวจผ่านเสมอ
1145:     if (!isDirectApproval) {
1146:       if (!pin) return { error: 'การอนุมัติแทนจำเป็นต้องระบุรหัส PIN ของผู้อนุมัติ' }
1147:       const pinCheck = await verifyEmployeePIN(actualApproverId, pin)
1148:       if (!pinCheck.success) return { error: pinCheck.error || 'รหัส PIN ของผู้อนุมัติไม่ถูกต้อง' }
1149:     } else {
1150:       // กรณีเซ็นเอง หากมี PIN ส่งมาก็ตรวจ (เพื่อความปลอดภัยเสริม) 
1151:       if (pin) {
1152:         const pinCheck = await verifyEmployeePIN(actualApproverId, pin)
1153:         if (!pinCheck.success) return { error: pinCheck.error || 'รหัส PIN ไม่ถูกต้อง' }
1154:       }
1155:     }
1156: 
1157:     // 2. Execute Transactional Approval via RPC
1158:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin.from('user_profiles').select('full_name, email').eq('id', actualApproverId).single()
1159:     const fullName = profile?.full_name || (overrideApproverId ? 'Unknown Approver' : session.user.email)
1160:     const email = profile?.email || session.user.email
1161:     
1162:     const isRemote = !isDirectApproval
1163:     const logDetails = `อนุมัติโดย: ${fullName} (${email})${isRemote ? ' [Verify by PIN]' : ''}${comment ? ` | Note: ${comment}` : ''}`
1164: 
1165:     const { data: rpcRes, error: rpcErr } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc('handle_approval_step', {
1166:       p_doc_id: docId,
1167:       p_doc_type: docType,
1168:       p_step_id: stepId,
1169:       p_approver_id: actualApproverId,
1170:       p_user_email: session.user.email,
1171:       p_sig_data: signatureData,
1172:       p_comment: comment,
1173:       p_is_remote: isRemote,
1174:       p_log_details: logDetails
1175:     })
1176: 
1177:     if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr
1178:     if (!rpcRes.success) return { error: rpcRes.error }
1179: 
1180:     // 3. Cross-module sync if final
1181:     if (rpcRes.is_final) {
1182:       await onDocumentFinalApproval(docId, docType)
1183:     } else {
1184:       // 📧 [Phase 2] Notify Next Approver
1185:       const { data: nextStep } = await supabaseAdmin
1186:         .from('document_approvals')
1187:         .select('*')
1188:         .eq('doc_id', docId)
1189:         .eq('status', 'pending')
1190:         .order('step_order')
1191:         .limit(1)
1192:         .maybeSingle()
1193: 
1194:       if (nextStep && nextStep.approver_id) {
1195:         const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[docType.toLowerCase()]
1196:         const { data: docData } = await supabaseAdmin.from(reg.table).select(`${reg.no_field}, ${reg.title_field}`).eq('id', docId).single()
1197:         if (docData) {
1198:           await notifyApprover(
1199:             nextStep.approver_id,
1200:             docId,
1201:             docType.toLowerCase(),
1202:             docData[reg.no_field],
1203:             docData[reg.title_field]
1204:           )
1205:         }
1206:       }
1207:     }
1208: 
1209:     return { success: true, isFinal: rpcRes.is_final }
1210:   } catch (err) {
1211:     console.error('submitApprovalStep Error:', err)
1212:     return { error: err.message }
1213:   }
1214: }

1216: // MIGRATION HELPER (Call once)
1217: export async function runWorkflowMigration() {
1218:   try {
1219:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1220:     console.log('--- START MIGRATION ---')
1221: 
1222:     // Checklist Migration
1223:     const { data: checklists } = await supabaseAdmin
1224:       .from('checklist_docs')
1225:       .select('id, status, approved_by, approved_at, assigned_approver_id')
1226:       .in('status', ['Closed', 'Pending Approval'])
1227: 
1228:     for (const doc of (checklists || [])) {
1229:       const { data: existing } = await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').select('id').eq('doc_id', doc.id).limit(1)
1230:       if (existing?.length > 0) continue
1231: 
1232:       const isApproved = doc.status === 'Closed'
1233:       let approverId = doc.assigned_approver_id || doc.approved_by
1234:       if (approverId && !approverId.includes('-')) {
1235:           const { data: p } = await supabaseAdmin.from('user_profiles').select('id').eq('email', approverId).limit(1).maybeSingle()
1236:           if (p) approverId = p.id
1237:       }
1238: 
1239:       // 🛡️ Determine role_required from config if not approved
1240:       let roleReq = 'admin' // Default fallback
1241:       if (!isApproved) {
1242:         const { data: config } = await supabaseAdmin
1243:           .from('workflow_configs')
1244:           .select('role_required')
1245:           .eq('target_type', 'checklist')
1246:           .eq('condition_value', doc.freq_type)
1247:           .eq('step_order', 1)
1248:           .maybeSingle()
1249:         if (config) roleReq = config.role_required
1250:       }
1251: 
1252:       await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').insert([{
1253:         doc_id: doc.id, doc_type: 'checklist', step_order: 1,
1254:         approver_id: (approverId && approverId.includes('-')) ? approverId : null,
1255:         status: isApproved ? 'approved' : 'pending',
1256:         role_required: roleReq,
1257:         action_at: doc.approved_at || null
1258:       }])
1259:     }
1260: 
1261:     // Incident Migration
1262:     const { data: incidents } = await supabaseAdmin
1263:       .from('incidents')
1264:       .select('id, status, signature_it, signature_reporter, signature_manager, resolved_by, created_by, approved_by, resolved_at, approved_at')
1265: 
1266:     for (const i of (incidents || [])) {
1267:       const { data: existing } = await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').select('id').eq('doc_id', i.id).limit(1)
1268:       if (existing?.length > 0) continue
1269: 
1270:       // IT Step
1271:       if (i.signature_it || i.status === 'Closed' || i.status === 'Pending Approval') {
1272:         await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').insert([{
1273:           doc_id: i.id, doc_type: 'incident', step_order: 1,
1274:           status: i.signature_it ? 'approved' : (i.status === 'Pending Approval' ? 'pending' : 'waiting'),
1275:           signature_data: i.signature_it, action_at: i.resolved_at
1276:         }])
1277:       }
1278:       // Reporter Step
1279:       if (i.signature_reporter || i.status === 'Closed' || (i.status === 'Pending Approval' && i.signature_it)) {
1280:         await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').insert([{
1281:           doc_id: i.id, doc_type: 'incident', step_order: 2,
1282:           status: i.signature_reporter ? 'approved' : (i.signature_it ? 'pending' : 'waiting'),
1283:           approver_id: i.created_by, signature_data: i.signature_reporter, action_at: i.resolved_at
1284:         }])
1285:       }
1286:       // Manager Step
1287:       if (i.signature_manager || i.status === 'Closed') {
1288:         await supabaseAdmin.from('document_approvals').insert([{
1289:           doc_id: i.id, doc_type: 'incident', step_order: 3,
1290:           status: i.signature_manager ? 'approved' : (i.signature_reporter ? 'pending' : 'waiting'),
1291:           signature_data: i.signature_manager, action_at: i.approved_at
1292:         }])
1293:       }
1294:     }
1295: 
1296:     return { success: true }
1297:   } catch (err) {
1298:     console.error('Migration Error:', err)
1299:     return { error: err.message }
1300:   }
1301: }

1303: export async function resetDocumentWorkflow(docId, docType) {
1304:   try {
1305:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1306:     const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
1307:       .from('document_approvals')
1308:       .delete()
1309:       .eq('doc_id', docId)
1310:       .eq('doc_type', docType.toLowerCase())
1311:     
1312:     if (error) throw error
1313:     return { success: true }
1314:   } catch (err) {
1315:     console.error('resetDocumentWorkflow Error:', err)
1316:     return { error: err.message }
1317:   }
1318: }
1319: 
1320: export async function adminResetWorkflow(docId, docType, password) {
1321:   try {
1322:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
1323:     if (!session || session.type !== 'internal') return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
1324: 
1325:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1326: 
1327:     // 1. Verify Admin Role
1328:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
1329:       .from('user_profiles')
1330:       .select('role, full_name')
1331:       .eq('id', session.user.id)
1332:       .single()
1333: 
1334:     if (profile?.role !== 'admin') return { error: 'Access Denied: Administrator role required.' }
1335: 
1336:     // 2. Verify Password (by trying to sign in with a fresh client)
1337:     const { error: authError } = await createClient(supabaseUrl, process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)
1338:       .auth.signInWithPassword({
1339:         email: session.user.email,
1340:         password: password
1341:       })
1342: 
1343:     if (authError) return { error: 'รหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง การยืนยันตัวตนล้มเหลว' }
1344: 
1345:     // 3. Reset Workflow in Main Table
1346:     const reg = WORKFLOW_DOC_REGISTRY[docType.toLowerCase()]
1347:     if (!reg) return { error: 'Invalid document type' }
1348: 
1349:     const updateData = {
1350:       [reg.workflow_status_field]: null,
1351:       [reg.status_field]: 'Open',
1352:       assigned_approver_id: null,
1353:       approved_by: null,
1354:       approved_at: null
1355:     }
1356: 
1357:     const { error: resetError } = await supabaseAdmin
1358:       .from(reg.table)
1359:       .update(updateData)
1360:       .eq('id', docId)
1361: 
1362:     if (resetError) throw resetError
1363: 
1364:     // 4. Reset document_approvals table
1365:     await resetDocumentWorkflow(docId, docType)
1366: 
1367:     // 5. Record Log
1368:     await recordLog(docId, docType.toLowerCase(), 'Admin Override', `ยกเลิกการอนุมัติ (Workflow Reset) โดย ${profile.full_name} ผ่านหน้าจอ Approval Logs`, session.user.email)
1369: 
1370:     return { success: true }
1371:   } catch (err) {
1372:     console.error('adminResetWorkflow Error:', err)
1373:     return { error: err.message }
1374:   }
1375: }

1377: /**
1378:  * ⚙️ Update Approval Configuration (Bypass RLS for Admins)
1379:  * Uses Service Role to update the primary approver for a specific frequency/type.
1380:  */
1381: export async function updateApprovalConfig(freqType, approverId) {
1382:   try {
1383:     const session = await getCurrentUserSession()
1384:     if (!session || session.type !== 'internal') return { error: 'Unauthorized' }
1385: 
1386:     const supabaseAdmin = getAdminClient()
1387: 
1388:     // 1. Verify Admin Role (Security Check)
1389:     const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
1390:       .from('user_profiles')
1391:       .select('role, full_name')
1392:       .eq('id', session.user.id)
1393:       .single()
1394: 
1395:     if (profile?.role !== 'admin') {
1396:       return { error: 'Access Denied: You do not have permission to manage approval flows.' }
1397:     }
1398: 
1399:     // 2. Perform Upsert via Admin Client
1400:     const targetType = freqType === 'Incident' ? 'incident' : 'checklist'
1401:     const category = freqType === 'Incident' ? 'high_priority' : 'general'
1402:     
1403:     const { error: upsertError } = await supabaseAdmin
1404:       .from('approval_configs')
1405:       .upsert({ 
1406:         freq_type: freqType, 
1407:         primary_approver_id: approverId || null,
1408:         target_type: targetType,
1409:         category: category,
1410:         allowed_roles: ['admin', 'it_staff', 'approver']
1411:       }, { onConflict: 'freq_type, category' })
1412: 
1413:     if (upsertError) throw upsertError
1414: 
1415:     // 3. Record Audit Log
1416:     const approverName = approverId ? 'Specific User' : 'System Auto-Approve'
1417:     await recordLog(
1418:       '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', // System-level config ID placeholder
1419:       'approval_config',
1420:       'Updated',
1421:       `ปรับปรุงผู้อนุมัติหลักสำหรับ ${freqType} เป็น ${approverName}`,
1422:       session.user.email
1423:     )
1424: 
1425:     return { success: true }
1426:   } catch (err) {
1427:     console.error('updateApprovalConfig Error:', err)
1428:     return { error: err.message }
1429:   }
1430: }
